tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// bka' gdams lha bzhi'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// byang chub thugs bskyed rgya chen tshogs gnyis bsags// stobs bcu'i dpung gis bdud bzhi ma lus bcom// 'chi med rtag brtan dam pa'i sku mchog brnyes// lha mi'i rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras de rgyal// de la 'dir thog mar ston pa thub dbang gtso 'khor gsum bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid shākya thub par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas ston pa thub pa'i dbang po gtso 'khor gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thal mo sbyar la/ dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas// bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags te// bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad pa'i// bcom ldan seng ge de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag bya/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod yon me tog la sogs pa thogs pa'i lha mo spros nas mchod par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar brjod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum/ tshogs zhing rang la bstim/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang zhes sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du zla ba'i gdan la rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig ser po ā lis bskor ba/ de 'od du zhu ba las rdo rje ser po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri dang zla ba'i steng du bdud bzhi mnan pa'i gdan la rang nyid bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas sa gnon/

g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ chos gos ngur smrig sku la gsol ba/ mtshan bzang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad brgyad cus spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ 'od dang 'od zer du ma 'phro ba/ de'i g.yas su byams pa sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rnga yab dang g.yon klu shing gi me tog bsnams pa/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rnga yab dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po bsnam pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing zhabs gnyis bzhengs nas bcom ldan 'das la lta zhing ldem pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khor gsum ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gtso 'khor gsum spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa la bstim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha spyan drangs/ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab/ rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo bzhis phyag tu bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas/ sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ gis dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag ye shes kyi bdud rtsis lus thams cad gang*/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la rigs lnga'am mi bskyod pa/ 'khor gnyis la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bstod par bsams la/ mchod bstod tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar bya/ byams pa la/ byams chen me yis sogs dang*/ spyan ras gzigs la/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sa bon la rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs nas/ gtso bo la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/

zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa dang*/ byams pa la/ oṃ mai tri maiṃ swā hā/ spyan ras gzigs la yi ge drug pa ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ 'khor gnyis gtso bo la bsdu/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi khar tshom bu dbus su che ba gcig dang*/ g.yas g.yon du chung ba re re bkod/ de'i mdun du zlum gtor gcig chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bsham/ bum pa dri bzang gi chu dang dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa stegs bu ji ltar 'os par bzhag dung chos rdor gzungs mi dgos/ de nas mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ las mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams bzang zhing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs lan gsum brjod/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung bzlas pa 'dod gsol dang bcas pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bsgom/ mdun bskyed kyi tshom bu la dmigs te/ badz+ra yak+ṣas bsang*/ swā bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du zla ba'i gdan la zhes pa nas rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs par sgrub thabs ltar la/ 'on kyang lhar bskyed pa na rang nyid ces mi sbyar/ de nas sngar ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa de/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ces pa la ar+ghaṃ sogs so so'i sngags sbyar la mchod pas mchod/ sngar bzhin bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang byin brlabs nas/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra hūm̐ swā hā/ i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pas mchod sbyin gyis gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdun bskyed la dmigs nas bzlas pa ji ltar rigs pa bya/ de nas bum pa badz+ra yak+ṣas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa nas/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa nang bcud kyis gang bar bsams la/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i phyag mdzub las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bum pa'i nang du 'bab par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ 'di la lha bskyed pa med/ bcu gcig zhal gyi bum sgrub dang 'dra bar 'dug de nas slob ma bos la khrus byas gral la 'khod pa ni/ me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o mar gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa kun slong byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa rnams kyang legs pa gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kha ba can 'dir thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i snang byed gcig pur gyur pa/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rnam rol sa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti sha'i thugs dam/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa rnams kyi lhag pa'i lha khyad par can rnam pa bzhi zhes grags pa las bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo sgrub pa'i skabs yin/

de la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba'i rim pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol gdab pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ thog mar slob dpon la thub pa'i dbang po dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes su gnang ba zhu snyam par gyis la maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de tshar ba dang*/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas khyed rang rnams phyag snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// lan gsum/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po gtso 'khor rnams la gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro bas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum/ slar yang thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po gtso 'khor gsum gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ dngos gzhi la rjes gnang gi gzhi lus sgrub pa'i slad du/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po dung pa zhig byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

de nyid la dmigs te slob dpon gyis/ swa bhā wa sogs/ zhes brjod pas gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri dang zla ba'i gdan steng du bdud bzhi mnan pa'i gdan la khyed rang rnams skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sogs nas/ ldem pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad thub pa'i dbang po gtso 'khor gsum gyi rnam par byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyi brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis ting shag rdung zhing*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra hūm̐ swā hā/ ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥ lan kha yar brjod cing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i yum bzhis bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba thogs te slob dpon dang lhan cig tu khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pa brjod cing bum chu khyor bar sbyin/ de ltar dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la rigs lnga dang 'khor gnyis la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyang khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ des lus kyi sgrib pa dag nas sku'i byin rlabs zhugs te sku'i rjes gnang thob pa yin/ gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon shākya thub par gsal pa'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba mar me gcig las gnyis chad pa'i tshul du byung*/

zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi sngags rim pa bzhin du rjes zlos lan gsum re byed du gzhug slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog 'thor ba dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te spyi bor bzhag pas snying ga'i sngags phreng byang chub ma thob bar du brtan cing nus ldan du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// des gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob pa yin/ slar yang slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas bcom ldan 'das gtso 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byon/ khyed rang rnams la sib kyis thim nas ye shes lha yi sku gsung thugs dang*/ khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du 'dres bar bsams la spros med rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ des thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa yin/ de ltar rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs ba'i bslab bya rnams la tshul bzhin du slob snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ lus longs spyod rnams kyang 'bul na cha shas nas bzhed la longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs gsum/ des jo bo bka' gdams pa rnams kyi thugs dam lha bzhi las/ thub pa'i dbang po gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/

bsod nams 'di yis sogs dpon slob thun mong du brjod pas dge ba bsngos la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang*/ rjes chog ni/ mchod pa kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs te mchod bstod sngar bzhin/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs nas/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs dang*/ badz+ra muḥbarjod pas tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ dge ba bsngo shis pa brjod/ 'di sngon du btang nas thub pa'i dbang po'i lta khrid rten 'brel snying po 'chad pa la 'jug go/ ༈ /thugs rje'i spyan ras 'gro drug sems can la// nam yang g.yo med gzigs pa'i skyob pa mchog /skyon bral gangs ri'i phung po lta bu'i sku// 'phags mchog gtso 'khor gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum bsgom par 'dod pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas ye shes tshogs bsags kyi bar sngar gyi 'gros sbyar bas shes/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo yi ge hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas bgrang phreng dang*/ g.yon 'og ma na pad+ma dkar po bsnams nas 'dab ma snyan gyi thad dkar kha bye ba/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang dmar po'i sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na sras nor bu 'dzin pa sku mdog ser po/ g.yon na yum yi ge drug ma sku mdog dkar mo gnyis ka'ang zhal gcig phyag gzhi/ rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang mthun pa/ zhabs gnyis phyed skyil du bzhugs nas gtso bo la zhal phyogs pa/ gsum ka'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur bas/

gtso bo la 'od dpag med/ 'khor gnyis la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar yi ge drug pas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros 'dus sems can gyi don byas par bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ci nus bzla/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'khor gnyis gtso bo la bsdu/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di'i rjes gnang ni maṇ+ḍal gyi khar tshom bu gsum/ mchod gtor bum pa rnams sngar bzhin bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs bdag mdun gyi rim pa sogs sngar bzhin du bya/ rjes gnang gi chings kyang lha sngags bsgyur ba ma gtogs sngar gyi 'gros ji lta ba bzhin sbyar bas shes so// 'di sngon du btang nas spyan ras gzigs kyi dmar khrid skyer sgang lugs 'chad pa la 'jug go/ ༈ /ye shes ral gris mi shes ma lus gcod// sdigs mdzub zhags pas bdud kun 'dar zhing 'ching*// bgegs la mche gtsigs rngam pa khro bo'i rgyal// rje btsun mi g.yo mgon pos 'gro 'di srungs// mi g.yo ba sgom par 'dod pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs sngar bzhin/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rang sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig mthing ga yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba sku mdog zar ma'i me tog ltar sngo ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ mi g.yo mnyam pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer bsdus pa/ sma ra smin ma me ltar 'bar zhing dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ mche bas ma mchu mnan pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdig mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa thugs kar bsnams pa/

mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sbrul dkar pos mchod phyir thog 'chang ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i gnas gsum byin brlab ye shes pa gzhug dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur bas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ ār+ya a tsā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ kye kye mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos kyang*// mtha' bral bde chen khro bo'i rgyal po'i sku// sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro don dpag med mdzad// 'jigs byed chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing*// srid pa gsum na dges pa'i gar mdzad pa// srid pa'i chu bo skem zhing bdud rnams 'joms// srid pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo thugs rje'i mgon// rab brjid mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can gyi mi shes pa'i mun pa dang bdud bzhi'i bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar bcad par bsams la/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ci nus bzla/ rje btsun mi g.yo bas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bdud bzhi'i bar gcod thams cad zhi nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di'i rjes gnang ni tshom bu gcig gis chog mchod gtor sogs sngar bzhin/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed bum sgrub rnams lha sngags bsgyur ba ma gtogs sngar dang 'dra/ rjes gnang gi chings kyang sngar gyi 'gros sbyar bas shes so// 'di sngon du btang nas mi g.yo ba'i khrid bram ze chen po'i chos drug 'chad pa la 'jug go/ ༈ /margad mdangs ldan sgeg mdzes yid 'phrog sku// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin 'gro la 'dod dgu stsol// g.yon na ut+pal gsar pa mnyen lcug ldem// blo gros mchog stsol ār+ya tā re rgyal// 'dir sgrol ma ljang gu gtso 'khor gsum bsgom par 'dod pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas ye shes tshogs bsags kyi bar sngar bzhin 'gros sbyar/

stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rang sems kyi ngo bo tām̐ yig ljang gu de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pa la'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su 'od zer can ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas mya ngan med pa'i shing dang*/ g.yon me tog ba ku la 'dzin pa/ g.yon du khro gnyer can nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing*/ zhabs phyed krung gis bzhugs pa/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur bas gtso mo la don yod grub pa dang 'khor gnyis la gtso mo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ ār+yā tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan sogs kyis bstod/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du tām̐ yig ljang gu la yi ge bcu pa dang gzungs sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can kyi don byas par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ brgya rtsa la sogs pa dang*/ gzungs ring ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā sa twā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re/ ma ma kṛ te/ sarba duṣ+ṭān/ pra duṣ+ṭān/ dzam+bha ya/ stam+bha ya/ mo ha ya/ bhan+dhā ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba tuṣ+ṭān/ staṃ bhā ni tā re swā hā/ ji tsam nus pa bzla/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol mas bdag sogs sems can thams cad 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las skyob pa dang 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral du gsol/

'khor gnyis gtso mo la bsdu/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di'i rjes gnang ni/ tshom bu gsum rim par bshams pa'i dbus su che ba/ g.yas g.yon chung ba/ mchod gtor bum pa rnams sngar bzhin bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed mchod bstod gtor ma bzlas pa bum sgrub rnams lha sngags bsgyur ba ma gtogs sngar bzhin/ rjes gnang yang sngar gyi 'gros sbyar bas

sngags ring thung gnyis ka'i bzlas lung mdzad/ shes par nus so// 'di sngon du btang nas sgrol ma'i khrid rjes dran lnga pa 'chad pa la 'jug go/ ༈ /theg chen chos kyi nying khu byams snying rje// byang chub sems 'byongs bka' babs bka' gdams pa'i// lha bzhi'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang cho ga'i tshul// bstan pa yun du gnas phyir 'dir bkod lags// de ltar bka' gdams lha bzhi'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa 'di ni rang gzhan kun gyis nyams su blang bde zhing bstan pa'i rgyun la phan par bya ba'i phyir thams cad mkhyen pa mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i zhabs kyi pad+mo las chos 'di'i bka' drin gyi bdud rtsi thob pa dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pas me mo yos lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos grags bzang po'o// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ thog ma'i brgyud rim jo bos bla ma so sor gsan cing*/ jo bos nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba la/ des rong pa phyag sor ba/ de nas bya 'dul 'dzin/ mkhan po chos kyi byang chub/ mkhan po zul phu ba/ slob dpon dkon mchog seng ge de gnyis ka las mkhas btsun tshul khrims rin chen/ bla ma dar ma bzang po/ chos rje gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rgyal mtshan don grub/ chos rje gtsang pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bya btang bo bhi satwa/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen grags pa/ spyan snga bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ snyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ lcags thang rab 'byams pa bsod nams dpal ldan/ thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ des bdag ngag dbang chos grags la'o/ kho bos sngar byas pa'i bka' gdams lha bzhi'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa zhig mchis kyang*/ slad nas thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi gsung rab 'di nyid lung rgyun dang bcas pa rnyed pas byin rlabs che bar bsams nas sor bzhag la/

rjes gnang gi skabs gsal byed phran bu dkyus su bcug pa'o// zhes 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos so// ༈ /bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid kyi yi ge mdo sngags lam gyi bcud 'dus zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ rab tu mi gnas ye shes dang*// zab mo rten 'brel chos mkhyen nas// 'jig rten gsum gyi lam ston pa// thub mchog de la gus btud de// stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug lam// rgyal ba sras bcas gshegs pa'i shul// gang de'i khrid yig mdor bsdus pa// bla ma'i gsung bzhin bri bar bya// 'dir lha chos bdun ldan gyi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mnyam med jo bo bka' gdams pa'i thugs dam lha bzhi'i ya gyal bstan pa 'di'i bdag po ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i lta khrid zab mo 'chad pa la/ bshad bya'i chos ngos bzung ba/ ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul/ skabs don gyi gdams ngag dngos dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje dang ldan pa des gdul bya rnams kyi dbang po'i rim pa dang mthun pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo mtha' yas shing bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bskor ba thams cad kyang bsdu na chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong du 'du/ de'ang bsdu na theg pa che chung gnyis las/ theg chen la rgyu lam byed mtshan nyid theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu lam byed rdo rje theg pa gnyis yod/ rdo rje theg pa la dbye sgo mang yang klu sgrub dang jo bo yab sras kyi bzhed pas/ mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud dang*/ bya spyod rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor bla med dang lngar bzhugs/ bya rgyud la rigs drug yod pa'i nang tshan de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la'ang rigs kyi bdag po gtso bo yab yum sogs kyi dbye ba mang du bzhugs pa las/ da lam skabs su babs pa 'di ni theg chen bya rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtso bor bye brag tu gyur pa yin no// gnyis pa la/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis chos 'chad pa'i lugs srol gnyis las skabs 'dir dpal ldan a ti sha nyid gang la byung ba'i 'brel gyis/

bi kra ma shī la'i mkhas pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes ltar/ mdzad pa po'i che ba/ chos kyi che ba/ 'chad nyan ji ltar bya ba/ gang 'chad bya'i chos dngos bcas sdom bzhi'i sgo nas 'chad pa la/ dang po chos 'di gang gis mdzad na/ lnga brgya pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu dpal ldan a ti sha mar me mdzad ces sa gsum na sku che ba'i yon tan yongs su grags pa des so// gnyis pa des mdzad pa'i chos de ji lta bu zhig ce na/ dpal jo bo rjes spyan ras gzigs dngos 'brom ston rin po che la lhag pa'i lha grangs med pa zhig gdam nga bskur ba'i tshe rin po che'i gling nas yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i lha bzhi gdam par mdzad pa'i thog mar bstan pa 'di'i ston pa/ bdag cag rnams kyi skyabs gnas gcig pu ba ston pa thub pa'i dbang po rdo rje gdan pa'i lta khrid kyi rim pa ste khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'i 'bras bu'i theg pa'o// de'ang 'di dag bya rgyud du 'chad kyang bya rgyud rang rkang tshugs pa'i lugs ni ma yin te ngo bor bya rgyud la/ rnam 'gyur rgyud sde'i rtogs pa bsres pa'o// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa che ba de ldan gyi chos dang 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs su babs pa na/ 'chad pa po slob dpon yang lus ngag yid gyi gnas ngan len spangs te tshul gsum dang ldan la/ nyan pa po rnams kyang snod kyi skyon gsum/ dri ma drug mi 'dzin pa lnga la sogs pa spangs nas 'du shes bzhi'am drug sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pas 'chad nyan bya ste skabs 'dir nus na rgyas par 'chad pa gal che'o// bzhi pa bshad bya dngos ni de ma thag par 'byung ba nyid do// gsum pa skabs don nyams len dngos la rgyud smin par byed pa dang*/ smin pa grol bar byed pa'i rim pa gnyis kyi dang po ni sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba legs par nod pa/ gnyis pa grol byed khrid kyi rim pa la sngon 'gro/ dngos bzhi/ rjes dang gsum gyis nyams su blang bar bya'o// dang po la gnyis/

thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'o// thun mong la gnyis/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim/ de blo ldog rnam pa bzhi la sbyar ba'i tshul lo// de las dang po ni/ spyir skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi mngon rtogs la sogs pa dkar po'i yon tan gyi chos thams cad skyed par byed pa la bu skyed pa'i ma dang 'dra bar med thabs med pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa tshul bzhin du bsten pa sngon du 'gro bas las dang las kyi rnam par smin pa la yid ches pas 'jig rten phyi mar myong 'gyur ngan song gi sdug bsngal la 'jigs te bsod nams cha mthun gyi las mngon par mtho'i tshul khrims srung ba la sogs pas lha mi'i bde 'bras la sbyor ba skyes bu chung ngu'i lam/ khams gsum gyi gnas mtho dman gang du skyes kyang me'i 'obs dang mi gtsang ba'i dong lta bu sdug bsngal dang de'i rgyu kun 'byung gi bden pa rtogs nas 'khor ba mtha' dag las nges par 'byung ba'i blos/ thar pa cha mthun gyi las dang lam gyi 'jug ldog tshul bzhin byas pa la brten nas gnas skabs kyi 'gog pa'i bden pa mngon du byed pa skyes bu 'bring gi lam/ srid dang zhi ba gnyis kar mi gnas pa'i snying rje dang shes rab kyis bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa la bslab cing spyod nas lam lnga dang sa bcu bgrod de mi gnas pa'i myang 'das sgrub pa skyes bu rab kyi lam ste/ de dag kyang snga ma snga ma la stegs byas nas phyi ma phyi ma'i blo bskyed dgos pas/ skabs 'dir yang go myang gi sgo nas rgyud la 'gre nges su bslab bo// gnyis pa gdams ngag pa rnams kyis blo ldog rnam pa bzhir thun mong gi sngon 'gror bsdus nas 'chad de/ de'ang dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa las rgyu 'bras rags pa tsam bsam pa dang skyes bu tha ma'i lam don gcig de steng las rgyu 'bras phra ba dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa rnams skyes bu 'bring po'i lam dang don gcig

de dag gi steng du lhag pa'i bsam pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa bsnan pa skyes bu chen po'i lam ste/ thog mar khams gsum srid pa mtha' dag la blo ma ldog na/ lam tshad ldan bsgom pa'i snod med pas skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim mtha' dag blo ldog rnam pa bzhir bsdus te rang gzhan thams cad srid las nges par 'byin 'dod kyi blo bcos ma min pa ma skyes kyi bar du bsgom pa gal che'o/ de dag gis sgom tshul rgyas pa ni khrid rim gzhan nas 'byung ba nyid ci nus su nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la lnga ste/ lam gyi rtsa ba/ mthun rkyen rdzogs pa/ 'gal rkyen sbyong ba/ byin rlabs 'jug pa/ mtshan bcas kyi rnal 'byor ro// de la dang po lam gyi rtsa ba la gnyis te/ theg pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba skyabs 'gro/ theg chen thun mong min pa'i rtsa ba sems bskyed pa'o// de dag gi go khrid rgyas par 'dir mi 'chad cing bsgom don snying po bsdu na dang po skyabs 'gro la gsum ste yul gang zag tshul lo// de yang bde ba'i stan la lus gnad dkyus mthun bcas/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro sngar 'byongs zin rung skabs 'dir lam tsam gsal gdab nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul gsal ba ni/ sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams bkod pa tshad med pa'i dbus su 'dod dgu char du 'bebs pa'i dpag bsam shing gi sdong po yal ga lo ma me tog rab tu rgyas pa'i dbus kyi snying por/ seng khri pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i ston pa bcom ldan 'das sprul sku'i cha lugs can bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor ljon pa'i bar mtshams rnams su/ dkon mchog rtsa gsum ye shes chos skyong gi tshogs dang bcas pa sprin 'khrigs pa bzhin du bzhugs par mos/ gang zag gang gis skyabs su 'gro na/ skyabs yul de dag gi mdun du tshe 'di'i pha ma dang sdang dgra gnod byed kyis gtsor byas/

mkha' khyab kyi sems can ma lus pa 'khod pa'i 'dren dpon rang nyid kyis byas te/ ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul ni/ lus gus pas phyag ngag gus pas skyabs 'gro/ yid gus pas dad mos rtse gcig pa'i ngang*/ 'di nas byang chub bar du skyabs su 'gro ba skyes bu chen po'i blo sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs 'gro'i tshig rgyas 'bring gang lcogs sam/ bsdu na sangs rgyas chos tshogs sogs ji tsam nus pa gsag gnyis pa sems bskyed pa la'ang gsum ste/ dmigs pa'i yul mkha' khyab sems can bsam 'og tu bcug ste/ dmigs pa'i gang zag rang nyid kyis dmigs pa'i rnam pa smon 'jug gi bdag nyid can du sems bskyed pa ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral te myur du bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i blos tshig ris rgyas pa gzhan nam/ bdag gis sbyin sogs la sogs pa brjod cing*/ mthar tshangs gnas bzhi la blo bzhag ste/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ mthar skyabs yul rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin nyes ltung sdig sgrib zhi/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs rgyas/ 'khor rnams 'od du zhu gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo 'od zhu rang la thim/ bla ma dkon mchog gi byin rlabs zhugs/ sems can thams cad dag pa'i zhing du song bar bsams la mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa mthun rkyen tshogs mchog rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal ni/ gong du skyabs yul bsdus na tshogs zhing slar gsal 'debs pa'am/ 'on kyang spros pa bsdu na skyabs yul mi bsdu bar de nyid tshogs zhing du byas pa'i mdun du/ ngo bo rang gzhan thams cad kyi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dus gsum du bsags pa ji snyed yod pa/ rnam pa gling bzhi ri rab snod kyi bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa la lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor sogs bcud kyi yon tan ma tshang ba med pa/

grangs sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab snyed dang mnyam pa/ rgya nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje can rnams la 'bul ba'i mos pas/ maṇ+ḍal dngos su nges par bshams te phyag len ltar rgyas par tshom bu so bdun ma sogs dang*/ bsdu na jo bos mdo las btus par grags pa/ sa gzhi spos byugs mas tshar brgya stong du phul ba'i mthar phul ba de dag tshogs zhing rnams kyis bdag gir mdzad/ bdag gzhan thams cad kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs te da lta nyid du 'tshang rgya nus pa tsam du song bar mos mthar tshogs zhing rang la bsdu'o// gsum pa 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ rang tha mal pa'i spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdor dril 'dzin cing longs sku'i chas rdzogs pa/ zhabs sems skyil du bzhugs pa'i g.yas kyi mtho bong rang gi smin mtshams la reg pa/ de'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po'i mthar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng dkar pos bskor bar mos la sems cung zad 'dzin/ rgyas par spro na yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed kyang 'gal ba med mod skabs don 'di tsam gyis 'thus gsungs/ spyir sdig ltung sbyong ba la gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang dgos pas de ni rten gyi stobs so// bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig ltung rgyu dang bcas pa la 'gyod cing gdung ba'i blo drag po bskyed pa sun 'byin pa'i stobs so// 'gyod pa des drangs te/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad sbyang bar mdzad du gsol snyam pa'i mos gus drag po dang bcas yid rtse gcig pas gsol 'debs kyi tshul du yig brgya bzlas pas/ thugs rgyud bskul/ sngags 'khor las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab/ zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong brtol te rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/

lus kyi phyi nang thams cad bkrus/ thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig ltung bag chags dang bcas pa dag par mos pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs so// mthar/ mgon po bdag ni sogs pa a bhi dha na'i rgyud tshig yin phyir skabs 'dir cung zad mi 'brel bas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas bdag gzhan sems can gyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdor sems 'od zhu rang la thim pas lus zag med lha'i sku/ sems rtog med chos kyi skur gyur par mos te mnyam par bzhag phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi dge ba la mi 'jug pa'i bsam spyod la gnas pa ni nyes pa slar lon gyi stobs te de dag dang ldan pa ni sdig pa sbyong ba'i gnyen po'i mchog go /bzhi pa byin rlabs myur du 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sbyor ba rten bskyed pa ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i gdan la ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma/ rnam pa zhing 'di'i bstan pa'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ sku gser gyi gtan pa phyis pa ltar 'od 'bar ba/ chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ phyag sa gnon mnyam gzhag zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba zhig bsam/ de la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sogs skyabs yul yod dgu cog thim pas dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi ngo bor mos la/ dngos gzhi gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ gdung shugs drag po dang bcas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag po yun ring bar btab/ rjes dbang zhu ba ni/ slar yang mos gus drag po bzod par dka' bas bla ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/

de nyid 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med mi phyed par gyur te dbang gi ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos la bzo med kyi rang ngo bskyang ngo*// lnga pa mtshan bcas kyi rnal 'byor thub pa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ sngon 'gro'i rjes thog tu yin na dngos gzhi la 'jug pas chog cing*/ skabs gzhan du skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sgom pa sngon du song nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ge brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ ser po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ sku las skyes pa'i 'od kyi phung po'i klong na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de ni dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag go /de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdakar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par sgom pa ni gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag go /de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ zhes pa ni ye shes pa gzhug pa sgrub pa'i yan lag go /slar yang 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ sarba ta thā ga ta abhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo bzhis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag ye shes kyi bdud rtsis lus gang*/ lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par gyur/ zhes rgyas gdab pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag ste bzhi rdzogs kyi lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba la yun ring du sems bzung nas yang nas yang du mnyam par bzhag pa la gtso bor bya/ de la sems mi gnas pa'am skyo na bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du mum̐ yig gser gyi kha dog can gyi mthar/ nang skor la/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ bar skor la/ tad+ya thā oṃ ga te ga te pā ra ga te pā ra saṃ ga te bo dhi swā hā/ mtha' skor la ye dharmā'i sngags phreng kha dog ser pos bskor bar bsam/ de las 'od 'phros lus gang sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'od zer phyir 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ tshur 'dus sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par mos pa bdag don byin rlabs kyi bzlas pa dang*/ yang 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ mchog gi go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer rang la thim par mos pa gzhan don phrin las kyi bzlas pa ste/ dmigs pa de dag la sems rtse gcig tu gzhol bas bzlas pa'i dngos gzhi'i mu ni la bya zhing*/ ga te sum cha tsam dang*/ mthar brtan byed du rten snying tshar kha shas bzlas la/ spro na mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ lha snang yang stong nyid du sbyang*/ 'od gsal gyi ngang la sems ci gnas su gzhag mthar dge ba bsngo'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ thabs kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems sgom pa dang*/ thabs byung don dam byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ byams pa sgom pa/ snying rje sgom pa/ de dag gi bogs 'don pa/ byang chub sems bsgom pa dngos so// dang po ni/ rgyu 'bras kyi man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas rim gyi sgom pa'am/ mdor bsdu na/ thog mar skye sla ba rtsa ba'i ma la dmigs te 'di bdag gi ma yin/

ma 'dis bdag gis dal 'byor gyi lus dang srog bskyed pa nas brtsams te phan tshad med pa btags/ gnod pa sna tshogs las bskyabs pa sogs drin che ba'i rgyu mtshan sgo du ma nas bsams la byams pa drag tu bsgoms la ma 'di bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa dung dung bya/ de la'ang 'byangs nas skye dka' ba tshe 'di'i dgra la bsgom/ de la'ang 'byangs nas rim gyis rgya je cher btang ste mthar sems can thams cad la bsgom mo// gnyis pa ni/ ma 'di 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang thabs la mi mkhas pas 'grub pa sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig 'grub pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu la spyod par 'dug sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'bras 'di dang bral ba zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam du snying rje shas mi bzod pa tsam du bsgom zhing*/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa dang mi 'bral bar bya/ rgya je che la bslab pa byams pa ltar bya'o// gsum pa de dag gi myong ba ci rigs pa skyes pa na/ bogs 'don tu mya ngan gyi 'dug stangs zhes pa lus tsog pur bya/ lag pa gnyis kyis 'gram pa skyor/ srin lag khar 'dzud/ ma rgan mdun du bsgoms la byams snying rje tshad med pa shugs bskyed la/ ngag tu'ang nga'i a ma zhes mang du brjod cing*/ de'ang rgya je che la bslab pa dang*/ khyad par du gang snying rje skye dka' ba de la phul tshugs su bsgom par bya'o// bzhi pa don dam byang chub kyi sems ni 'og nas 'byung bas 'dir kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems sgom pa ste/ 'di ltar ma rgan drin can 'di rnams snying rje snyam pa kho nas mi chog phan pa'i lan du phan gdags dgos par 'dug phan 'dogs po'ang bdag bu sdug pa kho na la bab/ gzhan la khag bsnyad sa med de thams cad ma yin par mtshungs/ phan phyogs re btags kyang phan pa med pas sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya/ da lta de'i nus pa bdag la med pas thog mar lam zab mo bsgom pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che la bslab par bya'o snyam du bsam pa dngos gzhi dang*/

yan lag tu gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa bdag la len cing*/ bdag gi bde skyid rgyu dang bcas pa gzhan la sbyin te/ de'ang dbugs dbyung rngub dang sbyar la dmigs rnam gsal ba'i phyir du 'od dkar nag gi rnam par spro bsdu byas kyang rung la/ re dogs med pa'i snying rje chen po dang ma bral ba gnad du che'o// spyir blo dman la rgyu 'bras bdun gyi man ngag dang*/ blo rab kyis bdag gzhan mnyam brjes byang sems btsan thabs su bslab par bzhed do// lta khrid kyi sngon du 'di nges par 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ sdud pa las/ ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su ma rdzogs par// de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi byed// ces pas tshogs bsags pa'i mchog gam phul ni byang chub kyi sems lhag pa'i bsam pa yin par shes par bya'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ rten zhi gnas bskyed/ brten pa lhag mthong btsal/ de gnyis zung 'brel du sbyong ba'o// dang po la gsum/ lus kyi gnad bca'/ sems kyi bzhag thabs bstan pa/ de las skyes pa'i nyams ngos bzung ba'o// dang po ni/ bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan 'bol chung sogs nyer bsdogs sngon du 'gro bas rkang pa skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam gzhag rgal tshigs drang por bsrang*/ mgrin pas ol mdud mnan/ lce ya rkan la sbyar/ mig sna rtse'i thad kyi bar snang la 'byed 'dzum med par lta/ sgrim slod ran pa'i lus gnad bcas pa tsam gyis sems rang gnas su 'gro ba la bslab/ de ltar lus gnad bcas pa'i rjes thog tu dbugs dbyung rngub gnas gsum ched du byas pa ma yin pa rang babs su rgyu ba nyid grangs nyer gcig tsam gyi bar du bgrang ngo*// gnyis pa la gsum/ rten bcas kyi zhi gnas/ rten med kyi zhi gnas/ ngo bo nyid la 'jog pa'o// dang po la ma dag pa shing bu'am rde'u phra mo la dmigs rten du byas te sems spro bsdu med par je re 'jog gsal bdo ba'i skabs su 'phro bcad/

yang dmigs rten la 'jog ste sgrim slod ran pos khab mig tu skud pa 'dzud pa ltar yengs su ma shor bar bya/ dag pa lha sku sogs sam khyad par shākya thub pa'i sku che chung ran pa dang cha tshad dang ldan pa zhig rang mdun nye ring 'tshams par bshams te/ byings na gtsug tor/ rgod na skyil krung*/ snyoms pa la thugs kar sems gtad de 'jog 'jog tshul sngar bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ rten can la cung zad goms nas dmigs rten de dag dngos su mi bzhag par yid kyis de 'dra ba zhig bsams pa la sems gtad de 'jog 'di la cha shas kyi rten bcas zhes zhal phyag sogs cha shas re re la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rten bcas zhes sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam cha spyi la sems 'dzin pa ste snga ma goms nas phyi ma la bslab/ gsum pa ni/ dmigs rten de dag gang yang yid la mi bya bar stong nyid kyi ngang du dgag sgrub bcas bcos med par cham mer 'jog pas yul dang yul can bsgom bya sgom byed sogs rtog pa'i 'phro 'du'i rlabs thams cad kun gzhi'i rgya mtshor thim par ma gyur gyi bar du nan tan chen pos zhi gnas kyi snyoms 'jug la brtson par bya'o// gsum pa de dag las skyes pa'i nyams ngos bzung ba la gnyis/ gzhung gi lugs dang*/ gdams ngag pa'i lugs so// dang po ltar na/ nyes pa lnga spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad bsten pas stobs drug gis yid la byed pa bzhi'i gnas skabs can gyi sems gnas dgu grub pa'i mthar shin sbyangs mi g.yo bar brtan pa la bya'o// de la spang bya'i nyes pa lnga ni/ dbus mtha' las/ le la

1 ོ dang ni gdams nga 2 ga rnams// brjed dang bying 3 sa dang rgod pa dang*/ 'du 4 mi byed dang 'ad 5 ུ byed dang*// 'di dag nyes pa lngar 'dod do// zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ de la le lo la gnyid sogs snyom las dang*/ bya ba ngan pa la zhen pa dang*/ sgyid lug pa ste gsum/ bying ba la rags pa dmigs shes kyi grims cha shor nas dmigs rten mi gsal ba'i tham tham dang*/ phra ba gsal cha yod kyang 'dzin stangs kyi shugs zhan pa gnyis/ rgod pa rags pa yul la ha cang chags pas gnyen pos kyang mi non pa dang*/ phra ba g.yo med du mi gnas par cung zad 'phro ba gnyis yod/ de dag spong ba'i gnyen po 'du byed brgyad bsten pa la/ le lo'i gnyen po bzhi ste/ rtsol 1 ba dang*/ 'dun 2 pa dang*/ rgyu dang ba 3 de ba/ 'bras bu des drangs pa'i shin tu 4 sbyangs pa'o// brjed pa la gdams ngag mi ba 5 rjed par byed pa dang*/ bying rgod byung ma 6 byung rtog cing byung na dmigs pa lta stangs spyod lam sogs kyis sel ba'i thabs la 'bad pa dang*/ bying rgod kyi gnyen po sogs 'du mi byed pa la rtsol sems kyis 'du 7 byed pa dang*/ bsam gtan la skyon med pa'i tshe rtsol bas 'du byed na 'du mi byed pa 8 la bslab/ stobs drug bsten pa ni/ thos 1 pa'i stobs/ bsam 2 pa'i stobs/ dran 3 pa'i stobs/ shes ba 4 zhin gyi stobs/ brtson 'grus 5 kyi stobs/ 'dris 6 pa'i stobs te dang pos sems gnas dang po 'grub la/ gnyis pas gnyis pa 'grub/ gsum pas sems gnas gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ bzhi pas lnga pa dang drug pa/ lnga pas bdun pa dang brgyad pa/ drug pas dgu pa 'grub bo// yid byed bzhi ni/ sgrims te 'jug pa/ chad cing 'jug pa/ chad pa med par 'jug pa/ lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa ste sems gnas dang po dang gnyis pa'i skabs su yid byed dang pos 'jug la/ gsum pa nas bdun pa'i bar du gnyis pas/ brgyad pa'i skabs gsum pas/ dgu pa bzhi pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa'o// sems gnas dgu ni/

sems 'jog kun tu 'jog nges par 'jog nye bar 'jog dul bar 'jog zhi bar byed/ nye bar zhi bar byed/ rgyun gcig tu byed/ mnyam par 'jog pa ste dgu'o// gnyis pa gdams ngag pa'i lugs kyis nyams lngar 'chad de/ dang po sems g.yo ba'i nyams ri gzar gyi 'bab chu lta bu/ gnyis pa thob pa'i nyams gcong rong chu bo lta bu/ gsum pa goms pa'i nyams chu bo dal 'bab lta bu/ bzhi pa rten pa'i nyams rgya mtsho rlabs dang bral ba lta bu/ lnga pa brtan pa mthar phyin pa'i nyams rkyen cis kyang mi g.yo bar gsal dwangs su gnas pa mar me rlung gis ma bskyod pa lta bu ste 'chad par nus shing spro na 'di dag gi tshul gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar rgyas par bshad do// gnyis pa lhag mthong gi khrid la gsum/ gang zag gi bdag med sgom tshul/ chos kyi bdag med sgom tshul/ de'i don ngo sprad pa'o// dang po ni/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri bo nyi shu la sogs pa 'jig rten na lta ba rnam par ma dag pa ji snyed mchis pa de thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa ni gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa ste/ de'ang gang zhe na/ sems can thams cad la nga'o zhes snyam pa'i lhan skyes kyi ngar 'dzin te/ de bdag med par lta zhing sgom pa la dpyad 'jog gtso che'i lugs gnyis yod/ don du gnyis ka zung 'brel dgos mod kyi gtso che ba'i dbang du byas na/ dpyad sgom pas rgyu la dpyod pa rdo rje gzegs ma la sogs pas rgyu'i bdag med dang*/ 'bras bu la dpyod pa yod med skye 'gog la sogs pas 'bras bu'i bdag med rtogs par mdzad cing*/ 'jog sgom gyi dbang du byas kyang thog mar/ gang zag gi bdag de rang bzhin gyis grub na phung po dang gcig dang du ma gang rung du grub dgos kyang de ltar ma grub pas tha snyad du phung po'i tshogs pa la brten nas nga zhes btags pa tsam las/ don dam pa rang bzhin gyis grub pa med pa'i tshul la nges shes bskyed pa sngon du 'gro ba tsam ni nges par dgos so// gnyis pa la/

gzung ba med pa/ 'dzin pa med pa/ spyi bkag pa'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ bdag ma grub pa de bzhin du bdag gir bzung ba'i phyi snod bcud dang nang phung khams la sogs pa'i yul ji snyed pa 'di rnams kyang rdul phran 'dus pa las byung bas rags pa ma grub/ rdul phran de'ang brtag na cha med du 'gyur bas phra ba ma grub ste/ mdor na chos thams cad rtog pas phar btags pa tsam du zad kyi don rang ngos nas bden par grub pa rdul tsam yang med de/ bum pa la bum 'dzin gyi shes pas glo bur du btags pa zad kyi bum pa gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir bum pa med pa'i snga logs su bum 'dzin gyi shes pa mi skye ba bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ yul la der 'dzin gyi shes pa sna tshogs pa 'char ba 'di dag kyang yul la brten nas byung bas bden par ma grub ste/ dper na rmi lam gyi snang ba rdzun pa'i phyir der 'dzin gyi rmis shes kyang rdzun pa las ma 'das pa bzhin yul rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa la ltos pa'i yul can shes pa nyid kyang bden par ma grub bo// gsum pa ni/ gzung 'dzin dang yod med yin min sogs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad bkag zin pa'i shul gyi spros bral spyi tsam dang shes pa rang rig rang gsal tsam du yang bden par grub pa med de yod med gnyis ka min pa'i phung po gsum pa shes bya la mi srid pa'i phyir dang*/ rang ngos nas spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phyir ro// de dag kyang rgyu 'bras la dpyod pa sogs dpyad pa rgyas par grub na sngar sa bon smos pa ltar ro// gsum pa ni/ de ltar dpyad pa'i grub 'bras snang lugs kun rdzob kyi ngos nas thams cad rang rang gi rgyu rkyen rten cing 'brel 'byung las skyes pa'i phyir med pa ma yin la/ gnas lugs don dam gyi ngos nas bdag med/ ngo bo'i rang bzhin med/ rgyu'i rang bzhin med/ 'bras bu'i rang bzhin med/ rten 'brel rang bzhin med/

yul rang bzhin med/ yul can rang bzhin med/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med/ dngos po rang bzhin med/ dngos med rang bzhin med/ snod rang bzhin med/ sems can rang bzhin med de rkyen las skyes pa'i phyir yod pa ma yin la/ de las gzhan du'ang grub pa med par ngo 'phrod pa de nyid rnam thar sgo gsum gyi mtshan nyid can gyi zhi lhag dbyer med snang stong zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin tu nges shes bskyed par bya'o// gsum pa zhi lhag zung 'brel du sbyong ba ni/ dpyad don ngo 'phrod pa de nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa ste/ de'ang dpyad pas sgro 'dogs chod de yul rang ngos nas spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral zhing bsam gyis mi khyab pa la zhugs pa de'i tshe/ yul can dpyod byed nyid kyang bsam brjod thams cad dang bral ba dper na bud shing zad pa na me zad pa ltar blo'i 'jug pa thams cad gnyug ma rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i ngang du thim nas gnas lugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang du sems sems byung gi spros pa mtha' dag nye bar zhi ba ni mthar thug pa'i 'jog sgom ste/ de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pa na lus ngag yid kyi gnad ma 'khrul ba dang ldan pas mnyam gzhag rnam pa'i mi rtog pa'i ngang du dang po hril gyis bsgrim/ bar du lhod kyis glod/ mthar rang so bzung la mnyam par 'jog rjes so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis bdag rang bzhin med pa lam du byas te bsgom mo// rtsa ba'i gsum pa rjes ni/ rjes kyi nyams len dngos dang*/ de'i yan lag go /dang po ni/ ji srid mi skyo'i bar du gnas lugs la mnyam par bzhag ste mthar thun las ldangs te/ thun mtshams kyi spyod lam la 'jug pa na/ bsam sgom bgyis pa la sogs pa'i dus gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa bas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la byang chub sems rnam pa gnyis skyes brtan gong 'phel du gyur nas byang chub chen po myur du thob par shog cig snyam pas/

bzang po spyod pa sogs theg chen gyi bsngo smon rnam par dag pas rgyas gdab/ spyod lam rnams su'ang yul snang la a 'thas bral ba'i stong nyid snying rje'i rnal 'byor dran pa dang shes bzhin bskyang bar bya'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ gegs sel dang*/ bogs 'don no// dang po ni/ ting nge 'dzin rtse gcig bsgoms pas khams 'dus te rlung stod du 'tshang ba'am/ snying mi dga' ba'i gegs 'byung bas/ mdun gyi bar snang la a dkar po zhig gsal/ gegs skyon dud 'tshub lta bu'i rnam par thon nas a la thim par mos te ha sprugs drag tu byas pas sel lo// nad byung na gang na sar bug pa dra tshag lta bu nas nad rlangs pa'i rnam par bton pa'am/ blo 'byongs na rang gi nad de'i steng du sems can thams cad kyi nad snang la rang bzhin med pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog gdon gyis 'tshe na de nyid pha mar thag bcad la btang len bsgom zhing dmigs med du 'jog gnyis pa ni/ bla ma la bcos min gyi mos gus drag po dang ma bral bas gsol ba yang nas yang du 'debs pa ni bogs 'don thams cad kyi mchog yin pas thabs mang du 'tshol mi dgos/ mdor na skyon yon gang la'ang dgag sgrub mi bya bar rang bzhin med par shes pas rang babs bskyang ba nyid gnad du che'o/ sbyangs yona~X ldan pas nan tana~X du// zab mo'i ting 'dzin 'di goms na// skye ba'i rgya~X mtsho~X mthar 'byin nas// rig dang zhabs su ldan par 'gyur// bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid las thub pa'i lta khrid kyi le tshan no// ༈ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ snyigs ma ldan pa'i zhing spyi dang*// khyad par gangs ri'i mgon gcig pu// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag der btud nas// de yi rnal 'byor 'dus gsal spel// gnyis pa jo bo bka' gdams pa'i man ngag grub thob skyer sgang ba'i bka' srol dang 'brel ba spyan ras gzigs snying rje mkha' khyab kyi khrid la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum/

dang po sngon 'gro la thun mong dang thun min gnyis/ thun mong pa thub pa'i lta khrid ltar 'chad/ thun mong ma yin pa la lnga las/ dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i gdan la bsam gtan gyi chas dang ldan pas 'khod de/ sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams su gyur pa'i dbus su dpag bsam gyi ljon shing rtse mo lngar gyes pa'i dbus mar seng khri pad zla'i gdan la bla ma spyan ras gzigs kha sar pa ṇi'i rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ mdun gyi yal gar spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa la yi dam lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ g.yas kyi yal gar sangs rgyas/ rgyab tu chos dkon mchog pusti'i rnam pa/ g.yon du theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun/ bar mtshams rnams su mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi tshogs ma lus pa bzhugs par mos la/ rang dang sems can thams cad lus ngag yid gsum gus pa chen pos skyabs su 'gro ba'i blo rtse gcig pas skyabs 'gro'i tshig rgyas pa/ bdag dang sems can thams cad legs pa'i lam ston bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam lha la skyabs su mchi'o// sku gsum ngo bo sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zab zhi spros bral dam chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sar gnas lam zhugs dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'gal rkyen kun sel srung ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa'am// bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan brgya stong du gsag gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad yid yul du byas te/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la bzhag par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi lam gyi rnal 'byor zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ deng nas bzung ste 'gro rnams sangs rgyas par// rang nyid zhi bde skad cig med par ni// smon pa dang ni 'jug pa'i bdag nyid du// nyin mtshan dge ba'i las la bskul bar bgyi// zhes sam/

bsdu na/ bdag gis sbyin sogs brjod/ gsum pa maṇ+ḍal ni lag len ltar legs par bshams te/ rgyas par na chos 'byung brgya rtsa las 'byung ba dze tā ri dang gnyis med rdo rje'i cho ga la sogs pa ltar ram/ de tsam mi nus na tshom bu so bdun ma nas/ bdun ma'i bar dngos su bshams pa de nyid rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bur dmigs la lan grangs mang por phul bas bdag gzhan gyi tshogs rdzogs/ sku las 'od zer byung sdig sgrib dag 'gro kun dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ slar mos gus kyi rkyen gyis skyabs yul 'od zhu rang la thim par mos/ bzhi pa rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ dkar po'i 'od kyi 'phro 'dus rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i sku snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ gi mthar yi ge brgya pas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ lus gang*/ sdig sgrib dag 'od zer phyir 'phros rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dang sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rang la thim par mos te gsal snang la mnyam par 'jog pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa bzla ba ci nus su bya/ mthar mi dmigs par bzhag lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla'i gdan gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma spyan ras gzigs dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pad dkar/ zhabs sems skyil/ dar dang rin po che brgyan pa/ 'od zer mu med par 'phro ba'i gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ mchod 'os thams cad spyan drangs te thim/ yid kyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ mos gus kyi yid rtse gcig pas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma spyan ras gzigs la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus su bskyar/ mthar bla ma'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can gyi rgyun bab/

rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ lus thams cad 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pas bla ma'i gsang gsum dang rang gi sgo gsum dbyer med mi phyed par gyur par mos la rang ngo bskyang ngo*// gnyis pa la gnyis/ mtshan bcas lha sgom pa dang*/ mtshan med de kho na nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ bde ba'i stan la lus rnam snang chos bdun nam rang lugs kyi skyil krung sogs mdor na bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'khod de/ rlung ched du rtsol ba med par rang babs su bzhag sems g.yo med dwangs gsal gyi ngang la gnas/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ rten srung 'khor sgom pa/ brten pa lha sgom pa/ lha'i gsal snang 'don pa/ bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul ba'o// dang po ni/ rang gi mal gyi phyogs bzhir hrīḥdamar po mgo gyen bstan re re/ steng 'og gnyis su hrīḥdamar mgo gyen dang mthur bstan re gsal/ mdun kyi hrīḥ'od kyi mig mangs ris su yol ba lta bur zhu/ de las 'od zer g.yas kyi hrīḥl phog de'ang sngar ltar zhu/ de'i 'od nub/ de'i 'od g.yon du phog nas hrīḥzhu ba sogs sngar ltar dang steng 'og gi hrīḥyang 'od du zhu/ 'gebs dang sa gzhi'i rnam par gyur te/ 'od zer gyi drwa ba dang khor yug can gyi gzhal yas khang bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang mi thar ba'i phyi rol du me ri rtse mo kha dog sna lnga pa can gyi gur khang gsal la brtan pa yun ring du bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i lte bar aḥdakar po/ de 'od du zhu/ lus kyi nang gang*/ 'od zer phyi rol du 'phros/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ snod kyi 'jig rten 'od du zhu/

bcud la thim/ de'ang rang la thim/ rang lus kyang mtha' nas dbus su yal bar mos te/ stong nyid kyi ngang du bzhag la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid hrīḥdakar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa de 'od du zhu ba las thig le dkar po gsum du gyur te/ de'ang dbus che/ g.yas g.yon gnyis chung ba/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las gtso 'khor gsum du gyur pa ni/ dbus su rang nyid thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba ltar kun nas dkar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dbu skra phyed dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi steng na mar 'phyang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pas mu tig gi phreng ba 'dren cing*/ g.yon gnyis pas ut+pal dkar po snyan gyi thad kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su jo bo nor bu 'dzin pa/ sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ dang po gnyis thal sbyar/ g.yas 'og mas rin po che dbang gi rgyal po yu ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ g.yon gnyis pas rin po che'i 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ pus mo btsugs nas spyan gnyis jo bo'i smin phrag tu gzigs pa/ g.yon du jo mo yi ge drug ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma rgyan cha lugs gtso mo dang mtshungs pa/ pus mo btsugs shing spyan gnyis jo bo'i thugs kar gzigs pa'o// gtso bo'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas jo bo gtso 'khor gsum mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ thal mo sbyar te/ jo bo thugs rje chen pos bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pas dam tshig pa so so la thim par bsam/ gsum pa la gnyis/ rtsa ba'i lha la gsal snang 'don pa dang*/ snying rje mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin sgom tshul lo// dang po ni/ te ltar gsal ba'i lha sku'i snang ba lam me ba de la sems bzung*/ de'i gsal snang ma shor ba'i ngang res 'ga' gdan nas gtsug tor bar/ res gtsug tor nas gdan gyi bar/ res spyan gyi dkar nag lta bu phra ba nas rags pa'i bar/ res rags pa phyag zhabs nas phra ba spyan gyi bar gsal gdab/ de dag brtan nas lha snang spyi la sems gtad de mthar ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad ma 'dres par shin tu gsal zhing blo rtse gcig pa la brtan pa thob par bya ste dmigs pa'i dngos gzhi'o// gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid pad zla'i steng na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ sku yis zhing khams thams cad du khyab cing zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho sku la rdzogs par lam gyis gsol ba'i sku lus kyi ba spu'i sgo nyi ma'i 'od ces pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig du ma dang*/ gser gyi ri khri/ re re la yang rtse mo khri nyis stong*/ rin po che'i khang bzang skyed tshal rgyan bkod du mas brgyan pa yi ge drug ma'i chos sgra sgrog pa/ ba spu de'i nang na'ang rgyal ba'i dbang po zhes bya ba'i ba spu'i khung bu na/ lha'i gser gyi ri brgyad khri rin po che'i brag ri ljon shing dag dang*/ zas gos lha'i rang bzhin las grub pa las byang chub sems dpa' dag longs spyod cing*/ yi ge drug pa'i chos sgra sgrog pa/ ba spu de 'das pa na sman chen po zhes bya ba'i ba spu'i khung bu na/

byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed ma thag bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong*/ rdo rje/ dngul/ gser/ in+d+ra nī la/ pad+ma rā ga margad/ shel gyi ri rtse mo brgyad khri yod pa/ dri za'i sil snyan gyi sgra las yi ge drug pa'i chos kyi dbyangs 'byin cing*/ gang sems thog ma bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa sems te/ kye ma'o zhes sdug bsngal skye rga na 'chi sogs la skyo bas skyil mo krung bcas te lus drang por bsrangs nas dran pa mngon par bzhag nas ri de dag la 'khod pa/ ba spu de'ang 'das pa na/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ba spu'i khung bu na/ rang sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma me 'bar ba dang*/ char 'bebs pa sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston cing*/ rin chen sna bdun las grub pa'i ri'i rgyal po brgya phrag stong dag la 'dod dgu 'byung pa'i dpag bsam gyi sdong po/ rtsa ba mu tig lo ma gser dngul/ me tog man shel las byas pa dag las rgyan cha du ma dang kā shi kā'i gos rnams 'phyang ba/ de 'dra ba'i ri rnams la rang sangs rgyas dag bzhugs nas gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyang yi ge drug pa'i sgrar ston pa/ thams cad kyi tha ma na ba spu'i khung bu rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal po na/ rin po che'i ri brgyad khri bzhi stong dang*/ dpag bsam dang tsan+dan dang byi ru'i shing de snyed yod cing rin chen 'bar ba'i khang brtsegs na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'dzam bu'i gling du mngon par phyogs shing chos 'chad pa/ phar phyin drug yi ge 'bru drug tu ston par mdzad pa'ang bzhugs pa sogs/ mdor na skra tsam khyon la dus gsum tshad snyed kyi/ sangs rgyas byang sems bzhugs nas/ la las ni dam pa'i chos kyi bgro ba mdzad/ la las ni phar phyin drug dang ldan pa'i chos 'chad/ la las ni rdzu 'phrul rnam par smin pa'i cho 'phrul ston pa thams cad kyang ye ge drug pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrog cing de dag las byung ba'i 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig ba spu'i sgo bye ba phrag brgya nas byung ste/

'gro drug gi sdig sgrib bag chags ma lus pa sbyangs/ kun kyang jo bo thugs rje chen po'i sku 'ba' zhig tu song nas yi ge drug pa'i sngags di ri ri bzla bar mos te rtse gcig dmigs pa'i ngang dang ma bral bar mnyam par 'jog go /bzhi pa ni/ de ltar bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin la gsal snang thon pa'am bsgoms pas skyo na bzlas pa la 'jug ste/ rang gi thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad kha steng 'og tu lta ba'i ltag sprod/ gyen lta'i dkyil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dkar po/ de'i mtha' skor du oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ zhes pa'i sngags phreng dkar po g.yas skor du 'khod par mos la rang nyid kyis bzlas pa byas pas sngags kyi sgra sems can thams cad kyi rnam par lhang lhang byung*/ don skye med kyi ngang du 'jog bzhin tu yi ge drug pa ci nus su bgrang*/ slar thugs ka'i sngags phreng 'od du zhu/ ngo bo yig 'bru la rnam pa 'od zer gyi tshul gyis spyi bo nas rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sang sang dag 'od zer phyir 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong bar bsam/ yang sngags phreng sngar ltar gsal btab cing bzlas pa dang 'od du zhu ba'i dmigs pa spel ma ji tsam nus pa bya/ mthar gong du bshad pa'i snying rje mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms la bzlas pa ci nus byas te/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe yi ge rnams pad+ma ltag sprod la thim/ de hrīḥl thim par mos/ gnyis pa mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor ni/ thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ bcud kyi sems can la phog de 'od du zhu/ de las 'od 'phros snod kyi 'jig rten la phog de dag 'od du zhu/ mtha' nas 'dus te 'khor gnyis la thim/ de gnyis gtso bo la thim/ de nyid yas mar nas zhu/ thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/ de'ang 'a chung ra la/ de ha la/ ha mgo bo/ mgo bo gi gu/

de yang 'od du yal ba'i ngang la ci gnas su bzhag mi gnas par 'phro bar brtsams pa na/ stong pa'i ngang las thig le gsum/ de'i dbus ma hrīḥ de las gtso 'khor gsum/ snod gzhal yas khang*/ bcud lha yi rang bzhin du mos/ 'di la ched du sbyang na/ slar bsdu zhing mnyam par 'jog ste lhar ldang ba sogs sngar ltar bya'o// gsum pa rjes la gnyis/ rjes kyi rnal 'byor dngos dang*/ zhar byung gi rnal 'byor gzhan bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ sgom bzlas ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor grub nas/ rjes spyod lam la 'jug pa na/ 'khor gnyis rang la thim/ rang phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis kha zas thams cad 'bru gsum gyis ye shes bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te rang lhar gsal bas longs spyad/ gos lha'i gos pañtsa li kār bsam de tshogs rdzogs pa'i yan lag tu spyad/ 'gro 'dug sems can la phan pa 'ba' zhig tu mos la bsngo smon rgyas par bya ba sogs theg pa chen po'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral bar bya'o// gnyis pa zhar byung gi rnal 'byor la gsum/ khyad par bde stong gi rnal 'byor/ thun mong byang sems kyi rnal 'byor/ lam gyi chad mthud 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po/ rang jo bor gsal mdun du lha mo yi ge drug ma bsgom/ de'i smin mtshams su thig le dmar po/ de las 'od zer dmar po tsha ba'i ngad ldan byung*/ rang gi smin mtshams su phog rang gi mgrin pa nas 'od zer dkar po bde ba'i ngad ldan 'byung*/ lha mo'i lte bar phog 'od zer dkar dmar 'dres pas sku lus nang nas yar song*/ slar smin mtshams nas 'od dmar po rang gi smin mtshams su thim pa sogs 'khor lo ltar bskor bas yab yum gnyis kar bde stong gi nyams skyes par bsams la/ bde ba ma skyes kyi bar du bsgom zhing bde ba skyes na stong pa dang bsre/ stong nyams kyi bde ba yal na slar 'od 'khor bsgoms la bde ba bskul/ mthar stong pas rgyas gdab/

'di bya rgyud rang lugs kyi thabs lam dod bltas pa'i bde ba lam byed kyi rnal 'byor ro// gnyis pa ni/ dang po rang gi mdun du rtsa ba'i ma de bsam/ ma 'dis bdag gi lus srog bskyed pa nas bzung*/ tshe rabs thams cad du phan pa tshad med pa btags/ gnod pa tshad med pa las bskyabs pa'i drin re che snyam du bsams la byams pa tshad med pa bsgom/ ma 'di thog ma med pa nas 'khor ba 'dir sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'bras 'ba' zhig la spyod cing thar dus ye med pa snying re rje snyam du snying rje tshad med pa bsgom/ ma 'di bdag kho nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bsgral te bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang la nges par 'god par bya'o snyam du byang chub kyi sems tshad med pa bsgom/ de la 'byongs na dgra bgegs dang*/ sems can mtha' yas pa la mtshungs par bya'o// gsum pa la sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi mdun du nye ring 'tshams par thugs rje chen po'i sku mtshan nyid dang ldan la yid chags pa bris 'bur gang rung bkram pa'i mdun du mchod pa bsham/ de thugs rje chen po dngos su gsal la mchod bstod bya/ bdag la re sa khyed las med do snyam pa'i blo gtad ling bskyur byas la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs so// rnam shes bde chen tu 'pho bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan mang du btab/ rang gi rnam shes hūm̐ dkar por gyur pa sna bug g.yas nas rgyang gis thon/ jo bo'i shangs bug yas nas thugs kar zhugs par mos la der sems 'dzin/ slar shangs bug g.yon nas byung*/ sna bug g.yon nas snying gar zhugs/ yang sna bug g.yas nas phangs pa sogs 'khor mar sbyang*/ mthar thun 'jog pa'i tshe hūm̐ rang gi snying gar thim pa'i rjes jo bo rang gi spyi bor byon/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsol ba gsol ba gdab pas/

jo bo 'od du zhu/ tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rang lus bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang bas 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang*/ rgas pa med pa'i lang tsho dang ldan par mos la bsngo smon bya/ gnyis pa ni/ nges par 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe nyer bsdogs sngar ltar byas la/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa mi dge ba'i rigs la bshags sdom yid tshim par bya/ lus longs spyod maṇ+ḍal du phul te zhen la this rbad kyis bcad la chags zhen dang blo ma bde ba spu tsam med par bya/ rang gi rnam shes hūm̐ dkar po sna bug g.yas nas thon pa sogs sbyang ba'i skabs ltar la/ jo bo'i thugs kar thim tshe 'od gsal gyi ngang du bzhag slar rnam shes tshur 'thon pa'i dmigs pa mi bya bar yang yang 'phang*/ des kyang 'pho ma nus na rang lus kyang 'od du yal te jo bo'i thugs kar sib kyis thim par mos te sems rtog med du bzhag pas/ rab 'od gsal du grol/ 'bring dang tha ma lha dang mir skye/ 'ja' 'od dang ring bsrel sogs ltas bzang po 'byung bar bshad do// khrid 'di stan thog gcig tu sgom pa'i tshe mtshan bcas rnal 'byor gyi skabs thog mar snod bcud 'od gsal du bsdus nas/ slar srung 'khor dang lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom par byas na lag len bde zhing don dang mi 'byor ba med do gsungs/ dal 'byor yo~Xn tana~X brgyad ldan lus// snying po len 'dod skal bzang dag /ma nor lam mchog 'dir zhugs shig /ting 'dzin rgya~X mtsho~X myur 'thob 'gyur// bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid las spyan ras gzigs snying rje mkha' khyab kyi khrid kyi le tshan no// ༈ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ phongs pa kun la dus drug tu// bu gcig ltar brtse rje btsun ma// snying gi ze'u 'brur rtag mchod de// rjes dran lnga yi khrid 'chad bya// gsum pa bka' gdams rin po che'i bka' srol las byung ba phrin las kyi lha 'phags ma sgrol ma rjes dran lnga'i khrid 'chad pa la gsum/

sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la gnyis te skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed do// dang po ni/ bsam gtan la 'jug pa'i sbyor ba spyi ltar la/ thun mong sngon 'gro gsal gdab pa sogs dge ba'i sems khyad par can gyis go phyes te/ sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing gi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rang mdun dpag bsam shing gi sdong po yal ga lngar gyes pa'i dbus mar rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la bla ma 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can la rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad 'od dpag med kyi rnam pas bskor ba/ mdun tu seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma la yi dam lha tshogs/ g.yas su sangs rgyas/ rgyab tu dam chos/ g.yon du dge 'dun/ mtha' skor du mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi tshogs bcas gsal gdab/ sems can thams cad yid yul du byas te/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma ci nus su brjod pas skyabs su 'gro/ gnyis pa ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rje btsun sgrol ma'i go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ bdag gi sbyin sogs mang du brjod/ mthar skyabs yul las 'od zer byung*/ rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ yon tan spel/ skyabs yul 'od zhu rang la bsdus te mnyam par 'jog gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga ste/ skyabs gnas bla ma/ lus lhar/ ngag sngags/ 'gro kun pha ma/ sems chos nyid du rjes su dran pa'o// de'ang rgyal ba 'brom rin po che la bka' gdams lha bzhi'i zhal gzigs pa'i dus su/ sgrol ma'i zhal nas/ sras kyi thu bo spyan ras gzigs// khyod kyi rjes 'brang kho mos bskyab// kho mo'i gdams pa 'di longs la// rjes su 'brangs la bstan par gyis// skyabs gnas bla ma dran par mdzod// lus ni lha yi rang bzhin te// ngag ni bzlas brjod rgyun du mdzod// 'gro ba ma lus pha mar soms// sems kyi gnas lugs stong par dpyod// lnga po 'di yi skya bar nas// dge rtsa thams cad dag par mdzod// ces gsungs pa'i bstan don rjes dran lnga'i zab khrid du grags pa ste/

de la'ang rjes dran dngos dang*/ phyi nang gsang ba'i go bab bshad pa gnyis/ dngos kyi dang po bla ma rjes su dran pa la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sbyor ba rnal 'byor gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gi snying gar snang ba kun rdzob thabs kyi ngo bo snod kyi thig le ser po sran ma bkas pa'i dbyibs lta bu/ de'i steng du stong pa don dam shes rab kyi ngo bo bcud kyi thig le gser mdog 'od lnga 'phro ba yungs kar gyi dbyibs can che chung snod dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can/ de'i spyi bo nas tho brtsegs su pad zla'i gdan chung ngu reg la ma 'byar ba re re'i steng du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa can du bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyi steng mar jo bo rje dngos bsgom/ jo bo'i dbu gtsug nas pad zla'i gdan gyi phreng ba kha gsum gyes pa'i dbus mar rdo rje 'chang*/ te lo nā ro/ ḍom+bi pa sogs nyams len byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa dang*/ g.yas mar byams pa/ thogs med sku mched sogs rgya chen sogs rgya chen spyod rgyud dang*/ g.yon mar 'jam dbyangs klu sgrub yab sras sogs zab mo lta brgyud rnams jo bo la thug gi bar phreng bar bstar te bzhugs pa/ de dag gi gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rtsa brgyud bla ma dang dkon mchog thams cad spyan drangs gnyis su med par thim pas dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid du mos/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi tshogs bsag cing gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bdag gzhan gyi lus zhing rdul grangs snyed du sprul nas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ lus longs spyod kha rje dbang thang dus gsum gyi dge rtsa dang*/ 'jig rten na mchod pa'i yo byad ji snyed yod pa thams cad kun tu bzang po'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin lta bur blos blangs te 'bul ba sogs yan lag bdun pa'i dmigs bsam rnam par dag pa la gnas te thun mong ma yin pa 'brom rin po che'i gsung*/

phyag dang phyag yul gnyis stong pa'i// rnam dag sku la ye phyag 'tshal// sogs bka' gdams glegs bam las 'byung ba ltar grub na legs/ thun mong bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa byas kyang rung la/ gang ltar bsags sbyong spel gsum gyi gnad bsdus pa'i tshogs bsags de nyid sngon du 'gro ba'i mos gus rtse gcig pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so// skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan mang du gsol ba btab/ gsum pa rjes dbang blang zhing de kho na nyid la mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ mthar mos gus drag po'i rkyen gyis rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lam gyis byung*/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib spyi dang khyad par lam gyi ye shes skye ba la 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa mtha' dag sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis gong 'phel du rdzogs/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ mthar gong ma 'od du zhu ste 'og ma la rim bzhin thim mthar rtsa ba'i bla ma yang bde ba chen po'i ngo bor zhu nas snod bcud kyi thig le la thim/ de'ang mi dmigs pa blo 'das brjod bral gsal stong zung 'jug gi rang mdangs bskyang ngo*// gnyis pa lus lhar rjes su dran pa la gnyis/ lha skur sgrub pa dang*/ gsal snang la bslab pa'o// dang po yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyis lha'i skur sgrub pa ni/ swa bhā bas stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing gi bkod pa tshad med pa seng ldeng nags tshal me tog 'bras bus brgyan pa'i ljon shing du mas gtibs pa'i dbus su/ pam̐ las pad+ma ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ las ut+pal ljang sngon tām̐ yig gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/

tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun 'phags ma seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma sku mdog ljang ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pal sngon po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ rin po che dang dar gyi na bzas brgyan pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ dbu skra li ba/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs can/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin can du gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang*/ thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i tām̐ yig ljang gu/ de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ lha dang lha min sogs kyis bstod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas yum bzhi bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa byung ste/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ spro na sngar ltar mchod bstod kyang bya/ 'dir yan lag bzhi sbyar tshul ni thub pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa dmigs pa'i gtso bo lha'i gsal snang la bslab pa la gnyis te/ rtsa ba'i gsal snang 'don pa dang*/ de la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ de ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrubs pa'i lha sku de nyid snang la rang bzhin med pa/ gsal la ngos bzung med pa/ bde la zhen pa med pa gsal lam mer yang nas yang du gsal gdab la/ rnam pa spyi'i gsal snang ma shor ba'i ngos/ bye brag phra ba nas rags pa'i bar/

rags pa nas phra ba'i bar gsal gdab la sbyang ste snang yul du dngos su gsal ba lta bu'i gsal snang la brtan pa thob cing*/ ji tsam 'dod kyi bar du gnas su btub pa'i gnas chab rten po ma byung gi bar du nan tan tu sbyang ngo*// gnyis pa la'ang gnyis te thun mong dang khyad par ro// dang po ni/ sngar bsgoms pa'i thugs ka'i tām̐ bskyar nas gsal gdab/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad ba mo la nyi zer phog pa bzhin tu sbyangs/ tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas/ sangs rgyas thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa rgyun ma chad par phul/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad 'od zer dang lhan cig tshur byung ste rang la thim par bsgom/ yang 'od zer 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*/ bcud kyi sems can rje btsun sgrol ma'i skur gyur par mos/ gnyis pa khyad par ni/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi dmigs pa skabs 'dir bya/ de'ang 'og gi las sbyor gyi skabs su 'byung ba nyid 'dir blang bar bya ste/ 'on kyang bzlas pa'i rigs dngos su mi dgos pa ni skabs 'dir khyad par ro// gsum pa ngag sngags su rjes su dran pa la'ang gsum ste phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o// dang po la gsum/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor ro// dang po la bzlas pa'i gzhi 'god pa dang dmigs pa dngos so// dang po ni/ rang sgrol mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la tām̐ yig sngo ljang*/ de'i mthar yi ge bcu pa yig ngo nang du lta ba g.yas skor du 'khod par mos la gsal brtan tu ma gyur bar bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ lus thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas/ 'od zer phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/

'od zer tshur 'dus/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad thob par mos te yi ge bcu pa'i bzlas pa ci nus su bya ba ni bdag don byin rlabs kyi bzlas pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ sngags las 'od zer 'phros/ rigs drug gi sdig sgrib bag chags bsal/ snod bcud snang la rang bzhin med pa 'phags ma'i zhing khams rten brten par bcas par gyur/ khyad par ba spu'i bu ga nas rang 'dra ba'i sgrol ma nam mkha'i khams khyab par spros/ 'gro drug gi sdug bsngal rgyu bcas bsal/ bde ba'i gnas la bkod par bsam ste yi ge bcu pa'i bzlas pa ci nus su bya ba ni gzhan don phrin las kyi bzlas pa'o// gsum pa ni/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi bzlas dmigs bya ba ste/ re re bzhin bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul bas rang gi thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'jigs skyob so so'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i 'od 'phros/ smin mtshams su sleb pa dang 'od kyi sne las so so'i sku dpag med 'phros pas mkha' khyab 'gro kun phyi nang gi 'jigs pa las dbugs dbyung*/ tshur 'dus rang la thim par bsam pa thams cad la 'gre'o// 'jigs skyob so so la seng ge'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma seng gdong mche ba gtsigs shing lce glog ltar 'khyug pa/ spyan ser mo mdog dmar zhing skra ser ba/ thugs kar mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa sems can rnams nga rgyal seng ge'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsam/ glang po'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma glang gdong shangs mtho zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ gsus pa 'phyang ba du ba'i mdog can/ mthe bong mngon par brkyang ba phyag gnyis kyis bsdigs par mdzad pa/ sems can rnams gti mug glang po'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgom/ me'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma dmar me 'bar ba'i gdong pa can zhal bdun/ ljags bdun/ skra gyen du 'bar zhing*/ phyag gnyis kyis pad+ma'i phyag rgya mdzad cing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/
