sems can rnams zhe sdang me'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgom/ sbrul gyi 'jigs skyob sgrol ma kha dog nag po sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bcu dang ldan zhing skra grol ba/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ sems can rnams phrag dog sbrul gyi 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgom/ chom rkun 'jigs skyob sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal khro gnyer bsdus pa/ skra gyen tu brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri/ g.yon sdigs mdzub/ rgyan gyis brgyan nas bzhengs pa/ sems can rnams lta ngan chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgom/ lcags sgrog 'jigs skyob sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo g.yas pa dang g.yon pa lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin cing rgyan gyis brgyan nas bzhengs pa/ sems can rnams ser sna lcags sgrog gi 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgom/ chu'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo/ phyag g.yas pas lcags sgrog g.yon pa sdigs mdzub/ zhi ba'i skur bzhengs pa sems can rnams 'dod pa chu'i 'jigs pa las sgrol par bsgom/ sha za'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ kun+da dang zla ba'i mdog can rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas g.yon mchog sbyin dang mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ sems can rnams the tshom sha za'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgoms la/ re re la'ang mos gdung dang 'brel bar yi ge bcu pa bzlas la/ tā rā tā rā zhes gnyis kyi sngags 'di dang*/ mthar tā rā mkhyen ces brjod do// gnyis pa nang gi bzlas pa la'ang gnyis thun mong dang*/ khyad par ro// dang po thun mong 'bru gsum rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ rlung ro bsal/ rlung rtsol med rang bab kyis nang du 'jug pa oṃ dkar po/ gnas pa āḥdamar po/ phyir 'gro ba'i tshe hūm̐ sngon por mos la ci nus su bgrang ngo*// gnyis pa khyad par yi ge bcu pa'i rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/

rlung ro bsal/ rlung rang bzhin gyis nang du 'jug pa yi ge bcu pa dkar po gnas pa yig bcu dmar po/ ldang ba yig bcu sngon por bsams la bgrang ba'o// gsum pa gsang ba'i bzlas pa la/ spyir ni sgra mtha'i bsam gtan zhes bya ba gong du ngag bzlas kyi skabs de dag gam dmigs bsal du'ang rung bar yig bcu'i sgra dril bu'am ting shag lta bu'i sgra mtha'i hā'i skad je phrar yal ba la sems gzhol ba dang*/ khyadapar yi ge bcu pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum sems kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo dang gnyis su med pa la sgra ni mtha' nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rang bzhin la blo bzhag par gsungs so// rtsa ba'i bzhi pa 'gro kun pha mar rjes su dran pa la gsum ste/ byams pa bsgom pa/ snying rje bsgom pa/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ thog mar skye sla ba rtsa ba'i ma la dmigs/ de nas skye dka' ba dgra lta bu/ de nas mkha' khyab kyi sems can la dmigs te/ de'ang mar shes/ drin dran/ drin bzo ba'i sems sngon du 'gro bas/ ma 'di bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang nges par ldan par gyur cig snyam du smon lam dang 'brel pa/ ma 'di rnams bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam du 'dun pa dang 'brel pa/ ma 'di rnams nges par bde ba dang ldan par bdag gis bya'o snyam du dam bca' dang 'brel pa'i tshul gyis nges pa ma skyes bar du bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar bde ba dang mi ldan pa de gang las byung na sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las byung bas sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig pa'i smon pa/ bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i 'dun pa/ bral bar bya'o snyam pa'i dam bca' ste snying rje tshad med pa 'brel pa sum ldan gyi nyams su blang*/ gsum pa ni/ de lta bu'i byams snying rje la brten nas sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi smon sems dang*/ de'i ched du sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu dang khyad par lam zab mo 'di nyid sgom pas nyams su blang ste mthar dbyung bar bgyi'o snyam du bsam pas sbyang*/

sbyor bas nan tan du de la 'jug pa'o// rtsa ba'i lnga pas sems stong par rjes su dran pa la gsum/ zhi gnas bsgom/ lhag mthong btsal/ de zung 'brel du nyams su len pa'o// dang po ni/ lus kyi gnad rnam snang chos bdun dang ldan pas/ ngag gi gnad dbugs 'byung gnas ldang gsum rang bab nyer gcig tu bgrang ba sngon du 'gro bas/ sems kyi gnad rten bcas shing bu rde'u lha sku yig 'bru sogs dang*/ rten med dmigs rten yid kyis bsam pa dang*/ dmigs rnam gang yang yid la mi bya bar ngo bo nyid kyi ngang du 'jog pa rnams la bram zes skud pa 'khal ba'i gnad grims lhod ran po'i tshul gyis nan tan tu bsgom ste byings rgod byung na bcos pas sems gnas kyi rim pa dgu dang 'brel ba'i nyams lnga po rim gyis skye bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa la gsum/ gang zag gi bdag med dang*/ chos kyi bdag med la nges pa rnyed par bya ba dang zung 'brel nyams su blang ba'o// dang po ni/ 'khor ba pa rnams la lta ba ngan pa rtag chad du lta ba la sogs pa'i rtsa ba lhan skyes kyi ngar 'dzin la gang zag gi bdag ces bya ste/ de nyid phung po lnga la brten nas btags pa tsam las don dam par grub pa med pa'i tshul la lung rig man ngag gis sgro 'dogs bcad de nges shes bskyed do// gnyis pa ni/ ngar 'dzin gyi shes pa des bskyed pa'i nga yir 'dzin pa/ phyi'i don du snang ba dang*/ don de 'dzin byed kyi shes pa dang*/ 'dzin pa bkag pa'i shul gyi shes rnam spyi tsam yang bden par grub pa med de ri bong gi rwa ma grub pas rwa'i rno brtul la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid gdags su med pa bzhin no// gsum pa ni/ de ltar dpyad pas chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i lhag mthong dri ma med pa de nyid/ man ngag gi myong ba dang sbyar te chos thams cad dmigs pa med cing brjod pa dang bral ba'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag

spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i stong pa nyid dang*/ rjes thob stong nyid rten cing 'brel 'byung du shar ba'i tshul la blo nges par byas te dran pa dang shes bzhin gyi rgyun bskyangs pas bden gnyis zung 'jug gi rtogs pa rnyed par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa rjes dran lnga po de rnams phyi nang gsang ba'i don dang sbyar te 'chad na/ dang po rang la thar pa'i lam ston pa ni phyi'i bla ma/ lta spyod zung du 'jug pa ni nang gi bla ma/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can ni gsang ba'i bla ma'o// gnyis pa lhag pa'i lha mtshan dpe'i skur snang ba ni phyi'i lha/ gzhi dam tshig par bskyed pa nang gi lha/ sems ye shes pa dang gnyis su med pa gsang ba'i lha'o// gsum pa sngags kyi gdangs ngag tu brjod pa phyi'i bzlas pa/ rlung yi ge'i rnam par bsam pa nang gi bzlas pa/ sgra mtha'i bsam gtan yid byed ni gsang ba'i bzlas pa'o// bzhi pa 'gro drug pha mar shes pa ni phyi'i byang sems/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po ni nang gi byang sems/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong nyid snying rje'i rang mdangs tsam du shes pa ni gsang ba'i byang sems so// lnga pa lung rig la brten nas chos thams cad stong par sgro 'dogs chod pa ni phyi'i chos nyid/ myong thog nas gsal stong zung 'jug mngon du gyur pa ni nang gi chos nyid/ sems kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de nyid chos kyi skur shes pa ni gsang ba'i chos nyid rjes su dran pa yin no// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la gnyis te/ dngos dang*/ zhar byung ngo*// dang po ni/ rang lhar bsgoms pa yin na bsdu rim dang thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang ba/ gnas gsum srung ba sogs spyi ltar byas/ dkyus gcig tu bsgom na byang sems kyis mtshams sbyar ba sogs mdor na thun mtshams la babs pa na/ theg pa chen po'i smon lam dang 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo bas rgyas gdab ste/

spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe snang grags rtog gsum rje btsun 'phags ma'i gsang ba gsum gyi lam khyer dang ma bral bar bya'o// gnyis pa zhar byung stan thog gcig ma'i nyams len ni/ sngar bshad pa de rnams stan thog gcig tu bsgom na/ skyabs sems dang bla ma rjes dran sngon du 'gro bas/ lha bsgom sngags bzlas ji ltar rigs pa'i rjes lha sku'i gsal snang 'od gsal du bsdus nas sems kyi gnas lugs stong par rjes su dran pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag de las thun mtshams kyi lha skur ldang ba na/ 'gro kun pha mar rje su dran pas dmigs pa med pa'i byams snying rje byang sems kyis mtshams sbyar te bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab cing*/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med tshogs gnyis zung 'jug gi lam la 'bad pa 'don par bya'o// lhar bcas yon gnas bka' gdams pa'i// thugs dam chos kyi bcud 'di la// nan tan 'bad nas byang chub kyi// spyod pa rgya mtsho mthar phyin smon// bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid las sgrol ma rjes dran drug gi khrid kyi le tshan no// ༈ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ ye shes khros pa sgyu ma'i gar// 'jigs byed bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms pa// mi g.yo mgon la phyag byas te// khrid tshul spyi dang bye brag 'chad// grub pa'i spyi mes sa ra has 'phags pa klu sgrub la bstan cing rim par brgyud pa dpal ldan a ti sha'i thugs dam gyi mchog tu gyur pa mi g.yo chos drug tu grags pa khyad par ba dang*/ gdams ngag thun mong ba'i lugs kyi khrid rim dag gung spros te 'chad pa la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum/ sngon 'gro la'ang lnga ste/ skyabs sems/ maṇ+ḍal/ yig brgya/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ tshogs gsag gi rnal 'byor ro// dang po la gnyis te/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni lam log pa las skyob pa ste go don blo la nges pas bsgom don dmigs par bya ba ni/ sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams gnas khang mtho khyad bkod mdzes kyi dbus su dpag bsam gyi sdong po yal ga lnga pa'i snying por seng khri pad zla'i gdan la/

bla ma mi bskyod pa sprul sku'i rnam pa can/ mdun du yi dam mi g.yo ba/ g.yas su rgyal ba shāka thub/ rgyab tu glegs bam/ g.yon du theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun/ mtha' skor dang bar mtshams su mkha' 'gro chos srung so so'i gtso mo la rigs mthun gyi 'khor dang bcas te bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ bdag dang mkha' khyab 'gro ba sgo gsum dad mos kyi 'jug pa gcig tu dril bas skyabs su 'gro bar mos te/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma ci nus brjod/ sems bskyed pa ni/ lam dman pa las khyad par du byed pa ste/ sems can de rnams la snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa sogs don yid la dran bzhin du brjod/ gnyis pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ byang chub bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen gyi gtso bo tshogs rdzogs par byed pa ste/ skyabs yul de dag tshogs kyi zhing du byas pa'i spyan sngar/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal rgyu bzang la bkod pas mdzes par bshams pa de nyid rgyur byas te/ yid kyis sprul pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi bkod pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi stobs las byung ba lta bu dang*/ bdag gzhan kun gyi dus gsum gyi lus longs spyod dge ba'i dngos po thams cad kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin tu blos blangs la 'bul te/ tshom bu so bdun ma sogs ji ltar rigs pa dang*/ sa gzhi spos byugs sogs grangs bcad du phul/ mthar skyabs yul rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag gzhan gyi sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sems can thams cad dag pa'i zhing du 'khod/ skyabs yul g.yas skor gyis 'od du zhu/ bla ma la thim/ bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim pas lus sems zag med kyi sku dang ye shes mngon du gyur pa mos/ gsum pa rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ byang chub bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen gyi gtso bo sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa ste/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdor dril 'dzin pa/

longs sku'i rgyan ldan zhabs sems skyil gyi sku las skyes pa'i 'od phung gi klong du bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig dkar po'i mthar yig brgya'i sngags phreng g.yas su bskor ba gsal gdab/ gsol ba btab pa'i tshul gyis yig brgya bzlas pas ngo bo thugs rje yul la 'jug pa'i ye shes/ rnam pa bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun babs pas lus kyi phyi nang bkrus/ sdig sgrib bag chags nad gdon la sogs pa dag pa'i dmigs rnam spyi dang mthun zhing*/ mthar bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas sogs sdom sems dang 'brel pa'i gsol ba btab pas/ sdig sgrib dag par dbugs dbyung stsal te 'od kyi rnam pas rang la thim par bsam/ bzhi pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni sngags kyi rnal 'byor la rten 'brel sgrig pa ste/ rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma mi bskyod pa sprul sku'i rnam pa skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gsal ba la mos gus gdung ba'i shugs drag pos/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// sogs gsol 'debs gang shes ci nus su byas pas/ bla ma'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byung*/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas sku gsung thugs kyi dbang dang byin rlabs thob/ mthar bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim par mos te thugs yid bsres la mnyam par bzhag lnga pa tshogs bsags la gsum/ sbyor ba tshogs zhing bskyed pa/ dngos gzhi tshogs gsog cing gsol ba 'debs pa/ rjes dbang blang zhing rang la bstim pa'o// dang po ni/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rang mdun nam mkhar pad nyi'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po thol gyis byung*/ de la sems cher gyis gtad pas de nyid 'od du zhu ste gtum chen mi g.yo ba sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon rdo rje'i zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod pa/

rin po che'i rgyan dang sbrul dkar po'i ga sha stag sham sogs khro bo'i chas can tshems kyis ma mchu mnan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bgegs rgyal glang po'i sna can brdzis pa/ khro chung dang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag nyid du mos/ gnyis pa ni/ yid kyis phyag dang lha mo me tog ma la sogs pa dpag tu med pa sprul te mchod cing bstod pas mnyes par bsam/ mos gus dang bcas te ngag tu/ jo bo mi g.yo bas bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ gsang sngags mtha' dag nyams su len tu rung ba'i snod du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bde stong zung 'jug gi rtogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan grangs mang du brjod/ gsum pa ni/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa la brten nas zhabs g.yas pa'i mtheb chen nas zag med kyi bdud rtsi dkar nar gyis thon te byung*/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad mer gyis khengs/ bde stong zag med kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skyes par mos la sems bzung*/ mthar yig brgya brjod de mdun gyi yi dam 'od du zhu/ rang la thim par bsam mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ thun mong du lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa chos drug gi rnal 'byor ro// dang po la bzhi/ bskyed rim gsal snang dang bcas pa/ thun mong me dmigs/ khyad par gzigs stangs/ thun mtshams srung ba'i rnal 'byor ro// de la dang po lha'i skur bskyed cing gsal snang la bslab pa ni/ bde ba'i stan la lus gnad bcas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus pa las skad cig gis rang nyid gtum po chen po'i lha'i skur wal gyis gyur pa ni/

sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ye shes kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon rdo rje'i zhags pa dang bcas pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dbu skra sma ra smin ma dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gnyis 'khyug cing tshems kyis ma mchu mnan pa/ rin po che dang klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan cing sbrul dkar pos se ral khar byas pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pas bgegs kyi rgyal po glang po'i sna can gyi steng na brdzis pa/ sprul pa'i khro chung du ma'i 'phro 'du dang*/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur/ slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs/ mchod cing gsol ba btab pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur sku gang*/ dri ma dag spyi bor mi bskyod pa sprul sku'i rnam pas rgyas btab par mos pa la lha sku'i snang zhen la yun ring du sems bzung*/ rnam pa spyi dang bye brag re re nas gsal brtan tshad du ma phyin gyi bar du gsal snang kho nar 'bad pas bslab bo// gnyis pa thun mong du me dmigs gsum bsgom pa ni/ rang lhar gsal ba de'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar yi ge bcu pas bskor ba gsal gdab/ de las drag po'i me lce 'jigs dus bskal pa'i me ltar/ tsha ba/ rtsub pa/ drag pa/ rno ba/ stobs ldan/ shugs can/ myur ba ste mtshan nyid bdun ldan 'bar/ thog mar hūm̐ sngags phreng dang bcas pa me nang du 'ur gyis 'bar zhing*/ de las kyang me lce 'khyog pos rang gi lus nang dmar mer gyis gang bas sdig sgrib nad gdon bag chags dang bcas pa skad cig gis bsregs par bsgom/ me dmigs dang po'o// de nas me cher 'bar te lus kyi sgo dgu nas kyang me lce sbrul gyi lce ltar dmar myug myug byung*/

mthar ba spu'i bu ga'i sgo thams cad nas kyang dmar lam lam mched/ phyi'i me ri'i gur khang dang 'dres pas mi mthun phyogs rnams cham kyis bsregs par mos/ me dmigs gnyis pa'o// de las kyang cher 'bar te 'dom dang mda' rgyang dang rgyang grags dang dpag tshad kyi bar du lhab lhab 'bar zhing mched pas bstan dgra gdug pa can rnams dang*/ nad dang dal yams kyi bdag mo mthu mo che rnams rgya mtsho'i mthar bskrad cing byer bar dmigs/ me dmigs gsum pa ste de dag gi skabs su sngags yi ge bcu pa ci nus su bzla'o// gsum pa spyan gyi gzigs stangs la brten nas bden gnyis zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor la bslab pa ni/ rang khro bo'i dbang por gsal/ mig g.yas pa steng du bteg pas spyan g.yas pa'i nang du yi ge mam̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zhig bsam/ des sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dang*/ rgyu 'bras rten 'brel/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la gzigs par bsam/ mig g.yon pa 'og tu gnon pas spyan g.yon pa'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zhig bsam/ des chos thams cad ci yang mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gzigs par bsam/ mig gnyis thad dkar lta stangs gtod pas spyan de gnyis kyi dbus su ye shes kyi spyan khra hur re ba zhig byung*/ des thabs shes dbyer med/ zhi lhag zung 'jug ste rtag chad yod med la sogs dbyer med zung 'jug la sa ler gzigs par bsams la rtse gcig mnyam par bzhag go /bzhi pa ni/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gis lha snang 'od gsal du bcug stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rang lus ye shes kyi ral gri sngo sangs me 'bar ba/ yu ba gser gyi sa gzhi la thug cing rtse mo tshangs pa'i 'jig rten tu slebs pa/ nang stong seng nge ba'i dbus su rang sems hūm̐ sngon por gsal ba la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag mthar stong par bsdus te thun mtshams kyi lha skur langs la gnas gsum srung ba sogs spyi ltar ro// drag las dang gral dpon byed pa/

phyogs ngan du 'gro ba sogs dgos pa dmigs su bsal ba yod na rang lus ral grir sgom bzhin pas bya ba byas na bar chad dang phyogs ngan la sogs pa'i gnod pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing*/ lar sba ba gsum tshang ba'i gdams ngag 'di shin tu zab pa yin gsungs so// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor chos drug la/ dang po bde drod gtum mo'i rnal 'byor la'ang gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ skyabs sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas lus gnad me thabs drug chings bya ste/ rkang pa bol gong bsnol la tsog pur sgyed pu ltar gzug lag gnyis zhags pa ltar bsdom/ mgo bo phub ltar dbub/ rgal tshig mda' ltar bsrang ste g.yo 'gul med par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ rlung gi rnal 'byor dang*/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po khyab byed rlung gi rnal 'byor la bslab pa ni/ rang mi g.yo bar lam gyis gsal ba'i sku'i nang dar sngon gyi gur phub pa lta bu stong chen sgrib thogs dang bral ba'i rkang mthil gnyis su me rlung gi ngo bo ram̐ yig dmar ljang re re gsal gdab/ rlung ro bus/ steng rlung dal gyis rngub/ 'og rlung bskum pa dang rkang mtheb gnyis cung zad bskyod pa'i rkyen gyis ram̐ gnyis las me rlung nar gyis byung*/ brla'i rtsa bo che brgyud de lte 'og tu slebs pa dang*/ srog rtsol thur sel bcas lhan cig tu 'dzom pa la shes pa gtad de dgang zhing gzhil/ mi thub tsa na dal bus sangs kyis bus de ltar sbyor ba bzhi ldan gyi rlung 'byongs pa'i rtags ma byung bar bsgom/ gnad phra mo ni zhal dang phyag len las shes so// gnyis pa khyab bya gtum mo'i rnal 'byor la gsum/ drod kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ bde ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ mi rtog pa'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po ni/ pus 'khyud bcug la nywa bzhi bsgrim pa sogs lus gnad sngar las grims cha che bar bya/

stong ra gsal gdab/ lte 'og sor bzhir chos 'byung dmar nag zur drug pa'i dbus su a shad dmar po gsal/ rlung ro bus/ rlung sngar bzhin bzung bas rkang mthil gyi ram̐ las me byung*/ sum mdor 'dres pas chos 'byung ngos/ a shad las me 'bar ba'i drod kyis lte ba'i 'khor lo nas rim par drod tsha 'ur gyis byung bar mos la thun bzhi sogs su brtson 'grus bskyed de lus la drod ma skyes kyi bar du bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ stong ra'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma gro sog 'bring po'i tshad tsam pa/ mtshan nyid bzhi ldan/ yar sne tshangs bug dang*/ mar sne gsus pa'i gnyer po cher sleb pa'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo dang g.yon tu rkyang ma dkar mo gnyis dbu ma las bldabs 'gyur gyis phra ba/ yas sna spyi bo nas sna bug gnyis dang*/ mas sna lte 'og nas dbu ma'i bar sner chud pa/ dbu ma'i yar sner ham̐ dkar po mgo bo mthur bstan phyed nub tsam/ mas sner a dmar po mgo gyen bstan phyed nub tsam/ lte ba'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar hūm̐ dmar po/ rtsibs drug la a shad dmar po re re/ mar sne'i a'i steng thad du ram̐ dmar po zhig bsam/ rlung ro bsal/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung bas a bskul/ ram̐ las me zangs khab lta bu gyen du 'bar bas 'khor lo g.yas su drag tu bskor/ hūm̐ yig a shad dang bcas pa las me dmar ba/ rno ba/ myur ba/ tsha ba/ 'u ru ru 'bar ba la dmigs pa gtad de drag la yun thung du sbyang*/ lus stong tshad pa'i yul yin pas ma 'byongs bar du thog ma nas me dmigs rigs stong du mi bya gsungs/ rlung gtong ba'i tshe dbu ma nas yar song bar bsams nas dbyibs su gtong*/ thun 'jog dus me rnams ram̐ la bsdu/ thun re re la bum pa can ci nus khams dang sbyar nas brtson pas de la brtan pa thob pa ni/ me lce rim par bsring ste snying ga tsam du slebs pa dang*/

spyi bo'i ham̐ g.yos bde ba skyes par mos/ snga ma la brtan pa thob nas phyi rim bzhin 'bar 'dzag bya ba rigs 'gre bas/ me mgrin par slebs pa dang ham̐ dros/ bde ba cher skyes/ spyi bor slebs pa dang ham̐ zhu la khad lta bur gyur/ bde ba de las kyang che bar skyes/ me lces ham̐ la reg ma thag tu thig pa gcig 'dzag me mthur du ded/ hūm̐ la thim bde ba tshad med skyes/ thigs pas hūm̐ la reg ma thag me snga ma las kyang cher 'bar/ spyi bo'i bar du song ba sogs 'bar 'dzag 'bros 'ded ma'i dmigs pa dang*/ mthar bde drod kyis lus thams cad kyang khyab pa la sems gtad de bsgom mo// gsum pa ni/ de dag gi skabs su drod dang bde ba dngos su skye na de la zhugs zhen 'dzin ma zhugs par mi rtog pas lam du byed cing stong pas rgyas gdab ste gnyis snang chos nyid kyi ngang du nub pa la brtson par bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni spyod lam thams cad du sngags spyi dang khyad par gtum mo'i dam tshig la gnas shing bde drod kyi nyams dang ma bral bar 'jam rlung bzung la gtum mo zas su za/ lus dang gdan gos sogs mer bsam pa dang*/ nyal ba'i tshe'ang khyi nyal sgor mo'am/ yang na seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis rting pa g.yas pas 'og sgo dgag dbugs sha phrag tu 'ong bar byas te gos su gyon/ 'gro ba'i tshe rdo spar bar chud tsam pa bcang*/ rlung ro bsal te steng rlung ran tsam mnan pa ni rta ru zhon pa'o// de ltar bsgoms pas dang po drod skye/ de la brten nas bde ba/ zung du 'jug pa las mi rtog pa skye/ de gnad kyis zin pas 'od gsal mtha' dbus med pa nam mkha' lta bu 'char bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa tshor 'dzin rmi lam gyi rnal 'byor la gnyis/ bzung ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// thog mar bzung ba la'ang gsum ste/ dang po kha zas ran cing gos srab la mal bde bar bya/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul zhing rmi lam zin pa dang 'byong ba'i gsol ba drag tu gdab/

rmi lam rmi lam du ngo shes par bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po btang*/ nus na tsog pu dang*/ mi nus na seng ge'i nyal stabs bya/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i smin mtshams su sa'i thig le ser po sran ma'i ga'u tsam pa/ phyed nang du nub cing phyed phyir mngon pa la sems gtad de gnyid log pas zin no// des ma zin na chu'i thig le dkar po/ des kyang ma zin na me'i thig le dmar po/ de la'ang ma zin na rlung gi thig le sngo skya la sems gtad/ de rnams kyis ma zin na gnyis pa 'dun pa drag tu bya ba ste/ nyin par gyi snang ba thams cad rmi lam yin snyam pa dang*/ ngag tu'ang nga gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam du 'dug ces pa la sogs pa brjod cing*/ ces kyang ma 'khrul bar bya snyam pa la sogs pa'i dran 'dun drag po rgyun chad med pa byas pas nges par zin no// da dung yang ma zin na gsum pa dmigs pa spogs chog gi gnad ni/ dran 'dun sogs sngar ltar la/ nyal khar snying pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su zla ba la hūm̐/ mdun du a/ g.yas su nu/ rgyab tu ta/ g.yon tu ra rnams sngo skya dwangs par bsams la sems yun ring gtad/ nyal khar thog mar hūm̐/ de nas a sogs g.yas skor gyis gnyid du 'gro khar ra la sems gtad de nyal bas nges par zin par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa la sbyong spel sprul bsgyur zhing khams lta ba sogs rgyas par chos drug gzhan dang mthun/ mdor bsdu na zin pa la brtan pa ma thob bar du 'og ma brtsam yang don mi 'grub cing*/ nam bzung ba'i tshe zin pa dang rtsal sbyong gcig las mang po spel ba/ mang po gcig tu sdud pa/ rang nyid dngos po dang sku gzugs yig 'bru phyag mtshan sogs su sprul pa dang*/ pho rmi na thugs rje chen po'am mi g.yo ba/ mo sgrol ma/ chur bying na sa gzhi/ thog bab na me tog gi char pa/ me chur bsgyur/ chu mer bsgyur ba sogs khyung du sprul nas 'phur te dag pa'i zhing khams lta ba la sogs pa gang 'dod du bslab bo// khyad par rmi lam ngos zin pa na nyin par gang la goms pa'i dge sbyor dang bsre ba gnad du bsnun pa dang*/

rmi lam gyi lus sgyu ma lta bu'i lha skur sbyong ba la gtso bor byed cing*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par lta ba'i thog nas rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid shes pa zhig nges par gal che ste/ dge sbyor 'di'i grub don gnyid kyi stong pa'i 'od gsal las rlung sems tsam gyi lha sku sgyu ma lta bur skad cig gis ldang ba goms pas 'chi srid 'od gsal las rlung sems tsam gyi bar srid 'char ba de sgyu ma'i skur ldang bar 'gyur ba'i ched du bshad pa'o// gsum pa kun rdzob sgyu lus kyi rnal 'byor la/ bsgom don dmigs pa'i gnad dang*/ ngo sprod pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ ma dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang ba dang*/ dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang ba'o// dang po ni/ rang gi mdun du me long g.ya' med pa mtho skor las mi chung ba zhig bzhag de dang rang gi bar du chu snod dwangs pa zhig kyang bzhag pas ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad gsal ba'i dgos pa yod gsungs/ de nas me long du 'char ba'i rang gi gzugs brnyan la mig dang sems yun ring du che re gtad/ de nas rang lus phar bsre/ nyams shar na de nyid rang lus dang tshur bsres te dbyer med du byas la bsgom/ sgyu ma'i nyams 'byongs na thog mar me long gi gzugs brnyan la bstod smad sna tshogs byed par bsam/ de la chags sdang mi 'dug na rang thog tu len/ de la'ang dga' mi dga' med par mgo snyoms na dngos su tshogs pa mang po'i gseb sogs su brtul zhugs spyod la sbyang*/ de la'ang chags sdang mi skye bar mnyam khad de song na 'byongs pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ me long chu snod sogs sngar ltar la/ yi dam gyi sku brnyan phyag mtshan sogs g.yas g.yon go ldog pa zhig rang gi rgyab tu bshams nas gzugs brnyan me long la 'char bar byas/ de la mig yid gtad de snang yang bden par ma grub pa'i sgyu ma la nges shes bskyed de yun ring du bsgom/ de la sems zin nas lha sku de rang dang me long gi bar du yod par bsgoms la sgyu mar sbyang*/

goms nas de nyid rang lus dang bsres te rang lus lha sku snang stong sgyu ma gzugs brnyan lta bu bsgoms pas 'byongs pa'i rtags khyad par gsum ldan du 'byung ste/ sku mdog bar snang la 'ja' tshon shar ba lta bu snang la rang bzhin med pa/ rgyan cha lugs me long ngos su gzugs brnyan shar ba lta bu gsal la ma 'dres pa/ snang tshul chu nang du zla ba shar ba lta bu yul thams cad la khyab pa ste/ de ltar 'byongs nas snang ba thams cad la bsre zhing 'byongs par ma gyur bar bsgom mo// gnyis pa ni/ rim lnga las/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan gyis// sgyu ma'i lus ni shes par bya// kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu// khyab pa chu yi zla ba'o// zhes pa snang tsam nas bden pas stong pa'i gsal snang khyad par can la sgyu lus zhes bya zhing*/ de lam du byed pa na/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sgyu ma'i rang gzugs su snang ba ni tshig don gyi sgyu lus te thos pas gtan la dbab/ yul snang dang tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum sgyu mar sbyong ba phar phyin dang thun mong ba ma dag pa'i sgyu lus dang*/ de dag lha sku sgyu ma lta bur bsgom pa rdo rje theg pa thun mong ma yin pa dag pa'i sgyu lus te/ spyi don gyi sgyu lus de dag bsgoms pas nyams su myong bas/ mthar rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i lha skur ngang gis ldang nus pa/ sbas don gyi sgyu lus kyis mtshams sbyar nas rtsa rlung thig le sgrib bral du dag pas 'ja' lus sgyu ma'i sku can slob pa'i zung 'jug rgyu dang*/ 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyis las nyon rtsa ba nas sbyangs te dri bral sgyu ma'i longs sku mi slob pa'i zung 'jug 'bras bu'i tshul gyis 'thob par 'gyur ba ni mthar thug gi sgyu lus so// bzhi pa don dam 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor la gnyis/ dngos dang zhar byung ngo*// dang po la'ang bsgom don dang*/ ngo sprod do// dang po la ril 'dzin dang rjes gzhig gnyis kyi/

dang po ril 'dzin gyi 'od gsal la bslab pa ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis lus thams cad gang*/ lha sku de thams cad stod nas smad dang*/ smad nas stod du 'dus te thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ de'ang zhabs kyu ha yig la/ ha mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ de'ang nā da shin tu phra bar bsdus te sems yun ring du bzung*/ mthar de'ang yal bar mos la rtog med kyi 'od gsal la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag ste de ltar yang yang bskyar la sbyang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ rang lha'i sku sngar bzhin gsal/ snod dang bcud thams cad me long la has btab pa yal ba ltar dus gcig tu 'od du zhu nas/ rang yang hūm̐ la bsdu ba sogs gong bzhin bya/ 'od gsal mi zin pa'i rgyu spang zhing zin pa'i rgyu bsgrubs la de ltar yang nas yang du bsgom zhing*/ khyad par gnyid du 'gro khar nan tan du bsgom pas srab mthug gi 'od gsal gang rung zin cing rim par je brtan du 'gro'o// gnyis pa ni/ rgyud blar/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gang yin pa// de ni nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med do// zhes gdod ma nas rnam par dag cing rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i chos khams nyid 'od gsal gyi mtshan nyid/ de lam du byed pa na/ tshig gi don gnas lugs gzhi'i 'od gsal de nyid lung rig gis dpyad pa dang nyams myong gi stobs kyis chos thams cad skye med stong nyid du rtogs pa phar phyin dang thun mong ba'i spyi don gyi 'od gsal/ ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gang rung gis chos thams cad 'od gsal du 'jug pa rdo rje theg pa thun mong min pa'i spyi don gyi 'od gsal goms shing 'dris pa las/ rlung sems dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum las byung ba'i dpe'i ye shes myong thog tu rang ngo 'phrod pa sbas don gyi 'od gsal gyis mtshams sbyar nas chos nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa slob pa'i gnas skabs dang*/

chos thams cad ye shes su rdzogs te 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pas chos sku klong 'byams su gyur pa ni mi slob pa'i gnas skabs te mthar thug gi 'od gsal lo// khyad par lam sgom pa'i tshe srab mthug nyams rtogs kyi 'od gsal 'char tshul sogs dbye ba phra mo ni gzhan las shes par bya'o// gnyis pa zhar byung zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor la bslab pa la gnyis te bsgom don dang*/ ngo sprod do// dang po ni/ de'ang gong smos dag pa'i sgyu lus dang 'od gsal dag gi grub don gyi tshul du 'byung ba ste/ mnyam gzhag tu lha sku snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa la blo bzhag pa'i snang cha de dang*/ de nyid dmigs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid kyi ngang du bsdus pa'i stong cha de nyid/ rjes thob tu zung du 'jug pa'i tshul gyis/ rtog med kyi 'od gsal de las rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i lha sku snang stong sgyu ma lta bu rang shar ba la bslab pa la skabs 'dir zung 'jug gi brdar bzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ bden gnyis dbyer med tshig don gyi zung 'jug thos pa la brten nas/ stong dang rten 'byung dbyer med du rtogs pa na phar phyin pa'i spyi don dang*/ ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gang rung las lha skur ldang ba sngags thun min gyi spyi don gyi zung 'jug ste/ de las rlung dbu mar thim pa'i stong pa bzhi skyed nus pa nas dpe'i 'od gsal dang sbas don gyi sgyu lus thob te rlung sems lha sku snang stong du ldang ba sbas don gyi zung 'jug dang*/ sa dang po nas bcu gnyis pa'i bar slob pa'i zung 'jug bcas grub nas/ mthar dag pa gnyis ldan gyi yul dang yul can gyi 'od gsal brtan pa chos kyi sku dang*/ rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i rten gzugs sku longs spyod rdzogs pa gnyis kyang ngo bo gcig la ldog pas tha dad du dbye ba ye shes kyi sku ni mthar thug gi zung 'jug ste/ de ltar na/

sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug rnams thog mar tshig don la brten nas shes rab khyad par can gyis spyi don nyams su blangs shing*/ thabs khyad par can rlung dang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor sogs kyis bskyangs pas sbas don 'grub/ de las slob pa dang mi slob pa mngon du 'gyur ba ni nang gi sa lam bgrod pa zhes bya'o// lnga pa lam gyi chad mthud 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor la gnyis/ sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// dang po la gsum/ sku gsung thugs kyi 'pho ba'o// dang po lus gnad dang ldan pas rang lus lhar gsal ba'i stong ra'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yar sne tshangs bug tu zug pa la ham̐ mgo bo mthur bstan gyis bkag cing*/ mar sne lte 'og tu phug rdugs su yod pa snying gar smyug ma'i tshigs 'gag pa lta bu'i pad+ma'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi rlung sems kyi ngo bo mi g.yo ba'i sku tshon gang la 'phar yed yed byed pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ sngo skya spus bris pa lta bu gsal/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma mi g.yo ba spyan drangs/ rang gi spyi gtsug tu bzhugs pa la yid kyis phyag mchod 'bul/ ye shes gong 'phor 'gyur ba'i gsol ba 'debs shing mos gus drag tu bya/ 'og sgo 'then/ tshigs pa bsrang*/ lag pa mnyam pa bzhag lte 'og tu bcar/ rlung ro bsal la/ rlung nang du mnan pas snying ga'i yi dam cung zad yar bteg par bsgom/ de bzhin bum can khug pa re res yar yar bteg nas mthar spyi bo'i ham̐ la reg reg 'dug par mos/ slar snying gar phab la rlung btang ba bcas de ltar rtags ma thon gyi bar du 'gro ldog spel mar sbyang*/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe tshangs bug ham̐ gis bkag yi dam snying gar brtan par bzhugs par mos/ gnyis pa ni/ lus gnad rlung sbyor dang ldan pas yi dam wal gyis bsgom/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ brjod pas chos thams cad sgra snyan tsam du bsam/ phaṭa ces brjod pas sems nyid brag ca yal ba lta bur bsam/

dge bshes sne zur ba sku 'da' khar/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing cung zad bzhugs nas phaṭa ces gsungs nas spyan gyen la hrig mdzad nas gshegs/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu rlangs pa ja khog kha bye ba tsam byung skad/ 'di 'pho ba kho nar ma zad mi ma yin gyi gnod pa bar chad byung dus kyang bsgoms pas 'phral du zhi bar gsungs so// gsum pa ni gzhan sngar sku'i 'pho ba dang khyad med cing dmigs pa'i bsgyur so snying gar sku bsgom pa'i tshab tu/ rlung sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig sngo skya/ 'og nas hi dmar pos 'degs shing*/ steng nas ka dkar po mgo thur bstan gyis gnon pa'i tshul du bsam/ rlung bzung*/ yid kyis ka zhes dal bur brjod pas kas yar 'then/ ham̐ zhes drag po'i tshul gyis brjod pas his 'phul nas rlung khug re re bzhin je mtho je mtho/ mthar ham̐ la reg reg 'dug ka zhes drag po yid kyis brjod pas des mnan te snying gar bab pa bsam 'phros sngar bzhin sbyang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ 'chi bslu sogs kyis mi zlog pa'i 'chi ltas byung ba na/ nyes byas la bshags sdom/ lus longs spyod la ma chags ma zhen par bla ma dkon mchog la phul te dag pa'i zhing khams su 'gro ba'i 'dun pa spro dung nge bas/ 'chi ba la bab pa na/ dmigs pa'i gnad snga ma rnams las rang gi goms cha gang la che zhing skabs der yid yul du 'char bde ba zhig la gnad du bsnun/ de'ang sku dang thugs gnyis las/ sku dang yig 'bru dbu ma'i yar sne'i ham̐ yig la bstim/ de nyid sku'am yig 'bru dang dbyer med du gyur pa spyi bo'i yi dam gyi thugs kar rgyangs kyis thim/ de nyid dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa'am mi dmigs par 'jog pa gang bder bya'o// drug pa blo chod bar do'i rnal 'byor la gnyis/ sbyang ba dang las la sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ tshogs drug gi yul dang snang tshad thams cad bar do yin/ de'ang bden par ma grub snyam du nges shes bskyed la drag tu bsgom/

blo 'byongs nas nges par bar do yin snyam du thag chod pa na/ sgyu lus 'od gsal sogs rang nyid dge sbyor gang la goms pa de dang bsre nas lam du khyer zhing gnad du btang bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'chi khar gzhi'i 'od gsal 'char ba'i skabs lam gyi 'od gsal la goms pas 'od gsal ma bu 'phrod par ma gyur na/ srid pa bar do'i snang ba 'char bas skabs der sngar gyi goms stobs kyis rgyu byas te/ bar do la bar do yin par shes pa'i tshe goms 'dris gang la che ba'i dge sbyor dang bsres te lam du btang*/ khyad par snang ba thams cad mi g.yo ba'i sku/ grags pa thams cad tsaṇ+ḍa ma'i sngags/ dran rtog thams cad rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes su rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ sgyu lus pas rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur bsre ba rang byin rlabs kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/ 'od gsal bas ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gang rung gis mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang*/ yang 'khrul snang 'char ba'i tshe zung 'jug gi lha skur ldang ba sogs kyis grol 'bras mngon du byed par 'gyur ro// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la gnyis/ dngos dang zhar byung ngo*// dang po ni/ mtshan bcas mtshan med rnal 'byor gang la 'jug kyang thams cad kyi rjes thog tu byang chub spyod pa smon lam khyad par can mang po gdab/ 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo ba dngos sam rjes mthun pas dge rtsa byang chub kyi rgya mtsho spel/ thun mtshams rnams su'ang dngos gzhi'i nyams myong dang ma bral ba'i dran shes kyis spyod lam la 'jug ste rnam pa kun tu nyams rtogs gong 'phel du 'gyur zhing sgo gsum don yod du 'gyur ba la bslab bo// gnyis pa zhar byung de thams cad stan thog gcig tu nyams su len na/ sngon 'gro yongs rdzogs sam bsdu na skyabs sems tshogs bsags tsam gyi rjes/ dngos gzhi lha'i rnal 'byor thun mong khyad par dang bcas rdzogs par bsgom pa'i mthar/

chos drug las gtum mo'i dmigs pa re dang*/ gzhan ji ltar rigs pa bsgom rjes 'od gsal du zhugs te/ zung 'jug tu ldangs nas srung ba'i rnal 'byor dang bcas thun mtshams la 'jug par bya'o// gnas skabs mthar thug yon tan kun// rnal 'byor 'di las 'byung ba'i phyir// zab cing rgya che'i bcud mchog la// skom pas chu mtsho bzhin tu rol// bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid las mi g.yo chos drug gi khrid kyi le tshan no// jo bo yab sras zhal gyi lung*// gdams ngag lugs dang man ngag lugs// zung 'brel mdo sngags kun gyi bcud// bdag gi skal ba bzang pos thob// lung rtogs cha shas ma rdzogs pas// legs bshad 'od dkar spro ba'i mthu// dman kyang kun mkhyen bla ma'i bka'// spyi bor mchod nas zin chung spel// dge bas skye bo thams cad kyis// stong dang rten 'byung tshul rtogs shing*// zab lam bgrod pa'i mthu thob nas// zung 'jug go 'phang mngon byed shog /ces pa 'di'ang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dge ba'i bshes kyi tshul ston pa khyab bdag thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas/ zab khrid bka' drin du stsal ba'i tshe re zhig 'bri bar 'os pa'i bka' stsal gnang ba/ sher brtson dman pas gsung rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo las cha tsam yang 'dzin par ma nus kyang bsnyel bar phongs te/ rje nyid kyis gnang ba'i sa bcad dang*/ smyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa dang*/ 'jam mgon kun dga' bsod nams kyi khrid yig sogs rtsa bar bzung*/ rje btsun grol mchog zhabs kyi khrid yig gi tshig don gnyis ka'ang tshang ba'i lugs su byas te/ rang blos gang dpog gi zin bris su snyom las pa yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi gdan sar bris pa bstan pa rin po che rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba dā maṅga laṃ//
